summary.note: Every card is voiced: passive-rule nerfs and passive-kind buffs play their family soundCue on spawn (see sounds.ts playPassiveCue); instant/activated buffs voice through the cast/signature system (playCardUse + signature voices). Fields are derived, not hand-authored.

cards.name: Bishop Polish
cards.description: One bishop can jump exactly one piece, twice.

cards.name: Bishop's Stroll
cards.description: Once, one of your bishops may step a single square straight up, down, left or right (capturing allowed), changing the color of its world forever.

cards.name: Castle Quiet
cards.description: When you castle, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Check Valve
cards.description: The next 2 times your king is put in check, your nerf is suspended for one of your turns, beginning after your opponent's following move.

cards.name: Crowned Calm
cards.description: The first time one of your pawns promotes, your nerf is suspended for your next 4 turns.

cards.name: Doorstop
cards.description: Choose an empty square beside your king: no enemy piece may move onto it for 3 turns. When placed, every enemy piece (their king excepted) standing next to that square is stuck for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Field Glasses
cards.description: Every enemy piece currently standing in your half of the board lights up until your opponent replies, and the spotted pieces hold their fire: they cannot capture on that turn.

cards.name: First Light
cards.description: The first capture you make suspends your nerf for your next turn.

cards.name: Garden Fence
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, for their following 2 turns they cannot capture your pawns standing in your half of the board.

cards.name: Grace Note
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next turn, gain 1 draft reroll, and learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Gum Drop
cards.description: Drop chewing gum under one enemy knight, bishop, rook or queen: it is stuck fast on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Hairline Crack
cards.description: Every one of your pieces that no other piece of yours defends lights up until your opponent replies, and the loose stone nearest your king is mortared: it cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Kind Omen
cards.description: The first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns. If that has not happened by your twelfth turn, the unused charge becomes 1 draft reroll instead.

cards.name: Knight's Errand
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may move a single square in any direction (capturing allowed).

cards.name: Leapfrog
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may hop diagonally forward over an adjacent piece, landing on the empty square beyond (never onto the final rank).

cards.name: Lucky Coin
cards.description: Gain 1 draft reroll. Spend a reroll within your next two draft offers and the coin lands heads: you gain that reroll back.

cards.name: Morning Stretch
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next turn, and gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Muddy Boots
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns cannot advance on their next turn, and every one of their pawns lights up until they reply.

cards.name: Night Watch
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Paper Crown
cards.description: Your king wears a splendid paper crown for the rest of the game (purely decorative), and you gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Pawn Umbrella
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, none of your pawns can be captured on their following turn.

cards.name: Pinch of Sand
cards.description: Add 15 seconds to your clock and gain 2 draft rerolls. In untimed games only the rerolls arrive.

cards.name: Promise of Rest
cards.description: The first time one of your pieces crosses into your opponent's half, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns and you gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: The Quiet After
cards.description: While your queen is off the board, your nerf is suspended, but the relief applies only to movement restrictions: you may move only one square at a time.

cards.name: Seven League Boots
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may stride up to three squares straight forward across empty squares (never onto the final rank). In exchange, your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Shared Silence
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, both players' nerfs are suspended for their following turn.

cards.name: Shoelace Knot
cards.description: Tie one enemy pawn's laces together: it cannot move on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Side Shuffle
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may step one square sideways onto an empty square. The square it lands on lights up until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Small Ritual
cards.description: The next 3 times you move your king, your nerf is suspended for one of your turns, beginning after your opponent's following move.

cards.name: Stutter Step
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, they cannot move the piece they just moved.

cards.name: Tiptoe
cards.description: Once, your king may move two squares in a straight line, if both squares are empty.

cards.name: Two Breaths
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next turn, and again for one more turn after your next 3 turns. On that final turn you may move only one square at a time.

cards.name: Vaulting Pole
cards.description: Once, after your opponent's next move, one of your pawns may vault straight over a piece directly ahead of it, landing on the empty square beyond (never onto the final rank).

cards.name: Warm Soup
cards.description: Thaw one of your pieces that is frozen or stuck: it can move again on your next turn.

cards.name: Watchman's Lantern
cards.description: Every enemy piece currently aiming at your king lights up until your opponent replies, and you gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Wheelbarrow
cards.description: Two of your pieces standing side by side (kings excepted) swap squares. Pawns cannot be wheeled onto a first or last rank.

cards.name: Butterfingers
cards.description: Your opponent's queen cannot capture for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Ancient Custom
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may capture an enemy pawn standing directly beside it en passant, as though it had just double-stepped. That pawn is then rooted and cannot move again on your next turn. Reaching your last rank this way promotes to a queen.

cards.name: First Blood
cards.description: The first capture you make in the game grants you one draft reroll, and reveals the tier of your opponent's next draft offer.

cards.name: Postern Gate
cards.description: An old side door swings open in the keep wall: your right to castle on both sides is restored, even if your king or rooks have already moved. Castling, as ever, can never be used to make a capture.

cards.name: Cold Feet
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, their pawns cannot capture for their following 3 turns.

cards.name: Cold Open
cards.description: Your opponent cannot move their queen for their next turn.

cards.name: Cold Snap
cards.description: Freeze one enemy piece, other than the king or your opponent's single most valuable piece, for 1 of its owner's turns.

cards.name: Deep Breath
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for one move, beginning after your opponent's next reply, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Diagonal Step
cards.description: Your king moves like a bishop on your very next move only: whether or not you take it, the charge is then spent.

cards.name: Drawbridge
cards.description: Your opponent cannot castle for their next 6 turns, though their first castling attempt slips through as one escape.

cards.name: Escape Hatch
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns; after your opponent's next move, your king swaps places with it, once.

cards.name: Extra Glance
cards.description: See your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Ferz King
cards.description: Your king may move two squares diagonally to an empty square, twice per game. It cannot capture.

cards.name: Lanternlight
cards.description: For your next 2 turns your king may move two squares in a straight line, as long as the first square is empty.

cards.name: Glowmoss Ward
cards.description: Soft light grows over your king's square and the eight squares around it: pieces standing there cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Thistledown
cards.description: Burrs tangle the enemy cavalry: for their next 2 turns, enemy knights may move but may not take anything.

cards.name: Foggy Glasses
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, their bishops cannot capture for their following 3 turns.

cards.name: Ghost Pawn
cards.description: One pawn may advance two squares by passing through a single enemy piece directly ahead of it, landing on the empty square beyond without capturing, once.

cards.name: Claw Machine
cards.description: One grab: 45% a plush mascot rides your king for 5 of your turns, 35% you peek at your opponent's next draft offer, 20% the claw drops a pawn onto your second rank.

cards.name: Consolation Scratcher
cards.description: Scratch it: 50% a random pawn of yours advances a free square, 30% you gain a draft reroll, 20% dust and a lovely sentiment.

cards.name: Loaded Dice
cards.description: Pick a pawn and roll two dice. Seven or more: it advances a square. Boxcars (twelve): it advances two. Under seven: the loaded dice grant one free re-roll before giving up.

cards.name: Penny Slots
cards.description: Pull the lever: half the time nothing, 35% one random pawn of yours sidesteps, 15% jackpot: a fresh pawn appears on your second rank.

cards.name: Raffle Ticket
cards.description: For your next 3 turns the drum spins after your move: 1 chance in 3 each time that a random pawn of yours marches a free square forward.

cards.name: River Card
cards.description: You and your opponent are each dealt a hidden card, ace low king high. Higher card wins: the winner steals a random enemy pawn, which walks across and defects. A tie splits the pot and nothing happens.

cards.name: Half Step
cards.description: One pawn moves diagonally forward without capturing, twice.

cards.name: Heavy Boots
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns cannot double-step for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Holy Hell
cards.description: Your pawns can never be captured en passant for the rest of the game, except your leftmost pawn, which stays exposed to it.

cards.name: Bad Omen
cards.description: A dark omen is read over their camp: on your opponent's 3rd turn from now, it strikes, and for that one turn they may move only a pawn or their king. They can see it coming and set up around it.

cards.name: Cold Footprints
cards.description: Their next move passes untouched, then for their following 5 turns: whenever they move a piece, the square it left freezes over for their next turn and no enemy piece may step onto it.

cards.name: Witch's Veto
cards.description: Their first move under the curse ignores the veto, one free strike. Then for the rest of your opponent's next 4 turns they cannot capture the piece you moved on your previous turn.

cards.name: Overexertion
cards.description: It takes hold after your opponent's next move, then for their next 5 turns: whenever they move the same piece they moved on their previous turn, it seizes up and is frozen for 1 of their turns. Kings never seize.

cards.name: Beneath Her Dignity
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their queen refuses to capture pawns.

cards.name: Borrowed Boots
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their king cannot step diagonally, straight steps only. The first diagonal step slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds.

cards.name: Buttoned Scabbard
cards.description: Your opponent's king cannot capture anything for their next 2 turns, except its first capture slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds.

cards.name: Caught Mid Stride
cards.description: Time hiccups: the piece your opponent moved on their last turn is frozen for 1 of their turns, exactly where it stands. Kings are never caught.

cards.name: Cobweb Corners
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, great webs fill all four corners for their following 3 turns: their pieces may not stop on the corner squares or the diagonal squares beside them (b2, g2, b7, g7).

cards.name: Cold Porridge
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns the infantry refuses breakfast every other morning: on the 1st and 3rd of those turns their pawns cannot move.

cards.name: Court Jester
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, one of their pieces, chosen at random (never the king), is appointed court jester: it wears the hat for 5 of their turns and, mid bow, is frozen for 1.

cards.name: Creaky Axles
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, their rooks may slide at most 4 squares.

cards.name: Curfew Horn
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, none of their pieces may move onto your back rank. The first piece to try slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds.

cards.name: Dunce Detail
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, one of their knights or bishops, chosen at random, is sent to remedial training: it wears the dunce cap for 4 of their turns and is frozen for 1.

cards.name: Dusty Boots
cards.description: One of your opponent's pawns, chosen at random, becomes a walnut for 1 of their turns: it can only shuffle a single square. Their most advanced pawn is spared and is never chosen.

cards.name: Early Frost
cards.description: The first pawn your opponent tries to advance slips through as one escape. After that, for their next turn, none of their pawns may advance. Diagonal captures still work throughout, and the frost lifts if no pawn ever pushes.

cards.name: Heavy Pockets
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns their pawns cannot make two square advances. Single steps only.

cards.name: Hiccups
cards.description: The first piece your opponent tries to move out of their own half slips through as one escape. After that, for their next turn, they may only move pieces standing in their own half. The hiccups pass if nothing ever crosses.

cards.name: Hopscotch
cards.description: The first light-square pawn your opponent tries to move slips through as one escape. After that, for their next turn, none of their light-square pawns may move: they are busy playing hopscotch. The game breaks up if no pawn joins in.

cards.name: Loose Horseshoe
cards.description: One enemy knight you target loses a shoe after your opponent's next move and becomes a walnut for 1 of their turns: no leaping, only a one square hobble.

cards.name: Matins Bell
cards.description: The first capture your opponent tries from the queenside files (a to d) slips through as one escape. After that, for their next turn, no piece standing on those files may capture: they are at morning prayers. The bell falls silent if nobody swings.

cards.name: Mild Sting
cards.description: A wasp circles their camp, in plain sight: after 3 of your opponent's turns it settles on one of their pawns, chosen at random. That pawn gets one legal escape move, then is stung and frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Mismatched Livery
cards.description: Their rooks are repainted as checkers pieces for 4 of their turns. The embarrassment takes a moment to sink in: after their next move, on the following turn their rooks may only move sideways along ranks.

cards.name: No Man's Reach
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their knights may not land on your two back ranks.

cards.name: One Way Cloister
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, their bishops may only move toward the a side of the board.

cards.name: Pebble in the Shoe
cards.description: One enemy pawn you target stops to shake out a pebble: it is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Pigeon Perch
cards.description: A pigeon lands on their king and refuses to leave for 3 of their turns. Not wishing to disturb it, their king does not move on their next turn.

cards.name: Plush Cavalry
cards.description: Your opponent's knights become adorable plush toys for 6 of their turns; stuffed hooves cannot fight, and after their next move their knights cannot capture for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Polite Infantry
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their pawns may not capture toward the a side of the board. Captures toward the h side are still allowed.

cards.name: The Puddle
cards.description: Choose an empty square: it becomes a deep puddle for 2 of your opponent's turns, and none of their pieces will stop in it. The first piece the puddle would turn away may step in once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Red Tape
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft offer excludes draft manipulation cards, and after that draft resolves you gain one reroll. The paperwork was misfiled.

cards.name: Royal Name Tag
cards.description: Their queen is issued a conference name tag reading SUSAN for 4 of their turns, and the indignity shows: she cannot capture on their next turn.

cards.name: Second Thoughts
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns they cannot castle. The king keeps re reading the paperwork.

cards.name: Sleepy Sentry
cards.description: One of your opponent's pawns on the a or h file, chosen at random, gets drowsy. It has one legal escape move, then falls asleep at its post and is frozen for 2 of their turns. If no edge pawn remains, nothing happens.

cards.name: Squeaky Wheel
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks cannot capture on their next turn.

cards.name: Tangled Reins
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their knights may not land on any edge square of the board.

cards.name: Thin Ice Patch
cards.description: The two central squares on your side of the midline (your d and e entry squares) turn to thin ice: your opponent's pieces may not stop on them for their next turn. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Will o' Wisps
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, wisp lights dance through their camp: each of their turns, one random empty square in their half becomes briefly impassable to them.

cards.name: Knock Knees
cards.description: Your opponent's knights cannot land on the rim for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Little Leap
cards.description: One pawn jumps a single blocking piece directly ahead, twice.

cards.name: Long Knight
cards.description: One knight makes two knight-leaps in a single move, once.

cards.name: Molasses
cards.description: Your opponent's queen slides at most 3 squares for their next 3 turns, though it may make one longer move to escape.

cards.name: Nudge
cards.description: Push one enemy pawn back one square if empty behind, once.

cards.name: Airmail
cards.description: Once, your a- or b-file pawn may capture the enemy piece directly in front of it.

cards.name: Alarm Lantern
cards.description: The first time the enemy gives check, every checking piece is marked until you reply, and you gain a draft reroll. One use.

cards.name: Back Alley
cards.description: Once, your a-file pawn may step one square sideways to the b-file. The destination must be empty; not a capture.

cards.name: Back to School
cards.description: One of your bishops wears the dunce cap. Purely cosmetic, mildly humbling. Free action; pick the bishop.

cards.name: Barometer Falling
cards.description: An omen flashes over your rooks until your opponent replies, and you gain 3 seconds on your clock.

cards.name: Border Report
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy piece currently in your half flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Border Stamp
cards.description: The first enemy pawn to reach its fifth rank is marked until you reply; since that mark changes no legal decision, you also gain a draft reroll and learn the tier of your next draft offer. One use.

cards.name: Bread for the Table
cards.description: Use once as a free action: a d- or e-file pawn carries the loaves one square forward. The square ahead must be empty, and no enemy piece may be attacking it.

cards.name: Bricklayer
cards.description: Use once as a free action: one of your queenside pawns (files a through d) cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Bridle Path
cards.description: Once, your b-file pawn may canter two squares from wherever it stands, if both squares are empty and one of your knights has already moved. The charge is spent if the canter is on offer and you play something else.

cards.name: Bulk Postage
cards.description: Once, your b-file pawn may capture the enemy piece directly ahead; if the a-file square beside it is empty, the pawn slides there instead of stopping.

cards.name: Camel Fair
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a camel leap, 3 by 1, in any direction. Not a capture; the landing square must be empty.

cards.name: Carbon Copy
cards.description: You will see the cards in your opponent's next draft offer.

cards.name: Cellar Hatch
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns on files a, b, g, h may step one square diagonally forward onto an empty square. Not a capture.

cards.name: Certified Letter
cards.description: Once, your c-file pawn may capture the enemy piece directly ahead only if that piece is defended. After the capture the pawn cannot be captured until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Chairs on Tables
cards.description: Use once as a free action: choose an empty center square (d4, d5, e4 or e5). Enemy pieces cannot end a move there for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Champion's Shades
cards.description: When you make your first capture of the game, the capturing piece puts on sunglasses, purely cosmetically, forever. One use.

cards.name: Change of Address
cards.description: When you castle, gain a draft reroll. If you have not castled by your 12th move, gain a draft reroll instead. One use.

cards.name: Chaperone
cards.description: The first enemy piece to move into an attack on your queen is marked until you reply, and you gain a draft reroll. One use.

cards.name: Choir Wings
cards.description: One of your bishops is issued ceremonial wings. This changes nothing at all. Free action; pick the bishop.

cards.name: Cloister Step
cards.description: Use once as a free action: step one of your bishops one square diagonally onto an empty square (not a capture); your c-file pawn nearest it then sidesteps one square toward that bishop if that square is empty.

cards.name: Closed for Cleaning
cards.description: Use once as a free action: rope off one empty square on your back rank. Nobody at all, yours or theirs, may end a move there for the next 2 turns.

cards.name: Coach's Whistle
cards.description: When you make your first capture of the game, every currently undefended enemy piece flashes until your opponent replies, and any temporary shield protecting one of them is removed. One use.

cards.name: Colt's Gallop
cards.description: Twice, one of your knights may make a zebra leap, 3 by 2, toward the enemy side only. It may capture on landing. A turn where the leap is on offer but not taken spends one use.

cards.name: Future Compost
cards.description: After your 7th move, your next draft offer rolls one tier higher. You are shown the pending reward one of your moves before it lands.

cards.name: Country Auction
cards.description: Use once as a free action: if your rook still stands on its home square (h1 for white) and your knight on g1, they swap places.

cards.name: Crane Swing
cards.description: Once, your queen may slide along its diagonals passing through up to 1 friendly piece (never capturing them), landing beyond as normal.

cards.name: Crystal Ball
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: see the cards in your opponent's next draft offer. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Curfew Patrol
cards.description: For your next 5 turns, any enemy piece that ends a move in your half is marked until you reply, every one of your pieces it could capture flashes, and you gain 5 seconds.

cards.name: Day Census
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy piece on a light square flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Dead Letter Office
cards.description: Once, your d-file pawn may capture the enemy piece directly ahead; the square it lands on is sealed to both players until your next turn, so nothing may move onto it.

cards.name: Distant Thunder
cards.description: Thunder rolls over the enemy king's square and over every enemy piece standing beside him until your opponent replies, and you gain 3 seconds on your clock.

cards.name: Do Not Disturb
cards.description: Use once as a free action: hang the sign on an empty square on your second rank beside one of your pieces. Enemy pieces cannot end a move there for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Doorman
cards.description: Use once as a free action: one of your pawns adjacent to your king cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Dowsing Rod
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: every currently undefended enemy piece flashes until your opponent replies, and you gain a draft reroll. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Drawbridge
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns (any file) may step one square diagonally forward onto an empty square. Not a capture. The step must angle toward the center files. If the step is on offer on your turn but you move elsewhere, the charge is spent.

cards.name: Driftwood Tower
cards.description: One of your rooks turns out to be carved driftwood. This changes nothing at all. Free action; pick the rook.

cards.name: Dromedary Post
cards.description: Twice, one of your knights may make a camel leap, 3 by 1, toward the enemy side only. Only to capture on landing; a leap onto an empty square is not offered.

cards.name: Early Bird
cards.description: After your 4th move, see your opponent's next draft offer and gain 5 seconds.

cards.name: Early Sprout
cards.description: After your 4th move, you learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer. If left unused, the reveal lapses after 2 of your drafts.

cards.name: Edge of the Map
cards.description: Twice, one of your pawns on the a- or h-file may step one square straight backward onto an empty square. The narrower district runs the errand twice. If unused by your 12th move, the remaining charge becomes one draft reroll.

cards.name: Evil Eye Bead
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: your queen cannot be captured during your opponent's next 2 turns. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Express Courier
cards.description: Once, your e-file pawn may capture the enemy piece directly ahead; on its following move that pawn may then advance two squares forward if both are empty.

cards.name: Ferry Crossing
cards.description: Once, your f-file pawn may cross two squares from wherever it stands. Both squares must be empty. The ferryman takes his fare: the crossing consumes your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Fetch the Flour
cards.description: Use once as a free action: a pawn on files a, b, c, d advances one square immediately. The square ahead must be empty.

cards.name: Field Sketch
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy knight and bishop flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Fire Escape
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns on files a, b, g, h may step one square diagonally forward onto an empty square. Not a capture. If the step is on offer on your turn but you move elsewhere, the charge is spent.

cards.name: First Class Stamp
cards.description: Once, your f-file pawn may capture the enemy piece directly ahead; when it does you gain 5 seconds and one draft reroll. In untimed games only the reroll applies.

cards.name: First Frost
cards.description: Frost settles on your king's square and on every pawn still in its bed until your opponent replies, and you gain 3 seconds on your clock.

cards.name: First Robin
cards.description: After your 6th move, one of your kingside (files e through h) pawns with an empty square ahead advances one square at random. If none can, you gain 15 seconds and it retries after each later move.

cards.name: Flea Market Find
cards.description: Use once as a free action: if your bishop still stands on its home square (c1 for white) and your knight on b1, they swap places.

cards.name: Follow Spot
cards.description: A spotlight marks your queen until your opponent replies. Nothing else happens.

cards.name: Fool's Gold
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: your king is gilded, purely cosmetically, forever. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Four Leaf Clover
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: your next draft offers three cards, rolled one tier higher. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Four Winds
cards.description: An omen flashes over the four corners until your opponent replies, and you gain 3 seconds on your clock.

cards.name: Foxtrot Slide
cards.description: Once, your king may move two squares diagonally forward toward the h-file. Both squares must be empty. When you take the dash you gain 5 seconds.

cards.name: Freight Elevator
cards.description: Once, one of your rooks may slide straight forward passing through up to 1 friendly piece (never capturing them), landing beyond as normal. If the slide is on offer on your turn but you play something else, the charge is spent.

cards.name: Fresh Footprints
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy pawn that has left its starting square flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Fresh Sod
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, enemy pieces cannot end a non-capturing move on the four center squares (a capture may still land there).

cards.name: Gallery Row
cards.description: Once, your d-file pawn may sidestep one square to an empty central-file square (c or e); the square it leaves is blocked to both players until your next turn.

cards.name: Garden Gate
cards.description: Once, your e-file pawn may step one square sideways to the d- or f-file (empty destination, not a capture); if it ends adjacent to a friendly pawn, both pawns resist en passant capture for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Garden Hedge
cards.description: Your queen may hop over an adjacent friendly pawn in any direction, landing on the square directly beyond, once. The landing square must be empty. The hop becomes available only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Gate Ledger
cards.description: The first enemy bishop, rook, or queen to leave its back rank is marked until you reply, and any temporary shield protecting it is removed. One use.

cards.name: General Delivery
cards.description: Once, your g-file pawn may capture the enemy piece directly ahead; doing so reveals the tier of your opponent's next draft offer.

cards.name: Gilded Doorknob
cards.description: When you castle, your king is gilded, purely cosmetically, forever; since that reveals nothing you could act on, you also gain a draft reroll and learn the tier of your next draft offer. One use.

cards.name: Giraffe Keeper
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a giraffe leap, 4 by 1, in any direction. Not a capture; the landing square must be empty.

cards.name: Goat Track
cards.description: Once, your g-file pawn may climb two squares from wherever it stands, forward or backward, if both squares are empty.

cards.name: Golden Aria
cards.description: The first time you give check, the piece that gave check is gilded, purely cosmetically, forever, every enemy piece it can capture flashes until your opponent replies, and you gain 5 seconds. One use.

cards.name: Gossip Charm
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: a random enemy piece is named Susan, purely cosmetically, forever. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Grand March
cards.description: Once, your king may move two squares straight forward. Both squares must be empty. If the dash is on offer on your turn but you play something else, the charge is spent.

cards.name: Grandfather's Watch
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: gain 4 seconds on your clock. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Green Room
cards.description: Once, while on your back rank, one of your knights may hop exactly 1 square sideways along it, ignoring anything between. The destination must be empty. The hop becomes available only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Guardian Sprite
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: your most advanced pawn cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Halo Round the Moon
cards.description: An omen flashes over your queen's square until your opponent replies, and you gain 3 seconds on your clock.

cards.name: Harbor Horn
cards.description: The first enemy piece to enter your half on the kingside files (e through h) is marked until you reply, and you gain a draft reroll. One use.

cards.name: Harbor Pilot
cards.description: Use once as a free action: one of your kingside pawns (files e through h) cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Harbor Walk
cards.description: Your a-file pawn may step one square sideways, once. The destination must be empty. If unused by your 12th move, the charge becomes one draft reroll.

cards.name: Lighthouse Walk
cards.description: Your g-file or h-file pawn may step one square sideways, once. The destination must be empty.

cards.name: Harborside Rider
cards.description: Your pawns on files e through h can never be captured en passant.

cards.name: Hearth Blessing
cards.description: If your first move is a d- or e-pawn move, the four center squares flash until your opponent replies. Judged once, on your first move. Your first move spends the card even when it is not a qualifying d- or e-pawn move.

cards.name: Hedgerow Buds
cards.description: After your 8th move, two of your outer-file (a, b, g or h) pawns with an empty square ahead are rolled at random, and the one nearer promotion advances one square. If none can, you instead learn your opponent's next offer tier and gain a reroll.

cards.name: Hired Muscle
cards.description: Use once as a free action: one of your knights or bishops cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Home Office
cards.description: When you castle, the castled rook is named Home Office, purely cosmetically, forever, and you gain a draft reroll. One use.

cards.name: Homesick Private
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns on files e, f, g, h may step one square straight backward onto an empty square.

cards.name: Homing Pigeon
cards.description: Twice, your h-file pawn may capture the enemy piece directly in front of it. The second capture must be on a different square than the first.

cards.name: Honor Roll
cards.description: The first of your pawns to reach your fifth rank is gilded, purely cosmetically, forever; since that reveals nothing you could act on, you also gain a draft reroll and learn the tier of your next draft offer. One use, automatic.

cards.name: Hoofbeat Log
cards.description: The first enemy knight to move is marked until you reply, every one of your pieces it could capture flashes, and you gain 5 seconds. One use.

cards.name: Horseshoe Nail
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: your next draft offer rolls one tier higher and you gain a draft reroll. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: House Lights Up
cards.description: The first time you give check, every square around the enemy king flashes until your opponent replies, and any temporary shield on those squares is removed. One use.

cards.name: Housewarming Gift
cards.description: When you castle, gain 9 seconds on your clock. One use.

cards.name: Identical Twins
cards.description: Use once as a free action: your two knights swap places with each other. They are identical, so nothing observable happens.

cards.name: Incident Report
cards.description: When the enemy makes their first capture, the capturer and every one of your pieces attacking it are marked until you reply, every one of your pieces the capturer could capture flashes, and you gain 5 seconds. One use.

cards.name: Intermission
cards.description: The first 2 times you give check, gain a draft reroll. 2 uses.

cards.name: Invitation Only
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, enemy pieces cannot end a move on your back two ranks. The ban is spent on that one opponent turn whether or not it actually turns a move away.

cards.name: Keys Copied
cards.description: When your opponent castles, you gain a draft reroll. 2 uses.

cards.name: King's Road Watch
cards.description: For your next 5 turns, any enemy piece that ends a move on your king's file is marked until you reply and loses any temporary shield.

cards.name: Lady's Escort
cards.description: For your next 4 turns, any enemy piece that ends a move next to your queen is marked until you reply and loses any temporary shield.

cards.name: Late Bloom
cards.description: After your 10th move, your queen is gilded, purely cosmetically, forever, and since that reveals nothing you could act on you also gain a draft reroll and learn the tier of your next draft offer.

cards.name: Late Spring
cards.description: After your 9th move, one of your pawns with an empty square ahead advances one square at random. If none can, spring comes anyway: one of your second-rank pawns, chosen at random, cannot be captured during your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Left Bank Atlas
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy piece on files a through d flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Locker Room Nickname
cards.description: When you make your first capture of the game, the capturing piece is named Champ, purely cosmetically, forever; since that reveals nothing you could act on, you also gain a draft reroll and learn the tier of your next draft offer. One use.

cards.name: Long Jump
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a jump of exactly 3 diagonally, clearing anything between. Not a capture; the landing square must be empty.

cards.name: Lucky Stirrup
cards.description: If your first move is a knight move, that knight becomes a plush toy, purely cosmetically, forever, and you gain a draft reroll. Judged once, on your first move.

cards.name: Margin Notes
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every currently undefended enemy piece flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Market Lane
cards.description: Once, your b-file pawn may sidestep one square inward to the c-file (empty destination, not a capture). On that pawn's next move this card grants both forward-diagonal captures, reopening a side another effect has closed.

cards.name: Meet Kevin
cards.description: One of your pawns is named Kevin, permanently. This changes nothing at all. Free action; pick the pawn.

cards.name: Meet the Neighbors
cards.description: When you castle, every enemy queen and rook flashes until your opponent replies, and you gain a draft reroll. One use.

cards.name: Morning Constitutional
cards.description: When your king makes his first non-castling move, he earns a hat, purely cosmetically, forever, every enemy piece he could capture flashes until your opponent replies, and you gain 5 seconds. One use, automatic.

cards.name: Nesting Doll
cards.description: One of your pawns becomes a nesting doll. This changes nothing at all. Free action; pick the pawn.

cards.name: Night Census
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy piece on a dark square flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Night Court
cards.description: Your queen adopts a tasteful vampiric wardrobe. This changes nothing at all. Free action.

cards.name: Night Custodian
cards.description: Use once as a free action: one of your rooks cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Old Post Road
cards.description: Once, on one of your first 7 moves, your d-file pawn may cover two squares from wherever it stands. Both squares must be empty. The coach never waits: the charge is spent if you leave the run on offer.

cards.name: Opening Chord
cards.description: The first time you give check, gain 8 seconds on your clock, plus a draft reroll and a look at the tier of your next draft offer; in untimed games only the reroll and the reveal apply. One use.

cards.name: Opposition Research
cards.description: When you make your first capture of the game, you learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer. One use.

cards.name: Painter's Lift
cards.description: Once, your queen may slide straight forward passing through up to 1 friendly piece (never capturing them), landing beyond on an empty square; it cannot capture on landing.

cards.name: Palace Floor Plan
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy piece adjacent to the enemy king flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Palace Gate
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns on the d- or e-file may step one square diagonally forward onto an empty square. Not a capture. If the step is on offer on your turn but you move elsewhere, the charge is spent.

cards.name: Parade Elephant
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make an elephant hop, exactly 2 diagonally, jumping anything between. Not a capture; the landing square must be empty.

cards.name: Parade Route
cards.description: Once, any pawn still on its starting rank may step one square sideways to an empty square. Taking this sidestep is your move for the turn, so no other pawn makes a special move that turn.

cards.name: Parasol Bearer
cards.description: Use once as a free action: your queen cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Penny Slots
cards.description: One of your pawns grows tiny slot reels. This changes nothing at all. Free action; pick the pawn.

cards.name: Pep Talk
cards.description: Your king's square is thumped encouragingly. Nothing else happens.

cards.name: Personal Space
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, enemy pieces cannot end a non-capturing move next to your king (a capture may still land there).

cards.name: Piggyback
cards.description: One of your pawns may hop over the friendly pawn directly ahead of it, landing on the square directly beyond, once. The landing square must be empty. The hop becomes available only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Pilgrim Road
cards.description: Once, your e-file pawn may stride two squares from wherever it stands. Both squares must be empty, and no enemy piece may be attacking the far one.

cards.name: Plaza Lantern
cards.description: For your next 4 turns, any enemy piece that ends a move on the four center squares is marked until you reply and loses any temporary shield.

cards.name: Plush Pony
cards.description: One of your knights is revealed to be a plush toy. This changes nothing at all. Free action; pick the knight.

cards.name: Pole Vault
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a vault of exactly 3 straight, jumping anything between. Not a capture; the landing square must be empty.

cards.name: Portrait of a Lady
cards.description: Use once as a free action: the enemy queen flashes on the board until your opponent replies. Every portrait needs a sitter, so if she has already fallen, the frame hangs on their king instead.

cards.name: Postern Watch
cards.description: The first enemy piece to enter your half on the queenside files (a through d) is marked until you reply, every one of your pieces it could capture flashes, and you gain 5 seconds. One use.

cards.name: Price Check
cards.description: You will learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer.

cards.name: Private Booth
cards.description: Use once as a free action, while your king still sits at his own table: reserve one empty square beside him. No enemy piece may end a move there during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Prompt Corner
cards.description: Once, while on your back rank, one of your bishops may hop exactly 1 square sideways along it, ignoring anything between. The destination must be empty. Taking this hop consumes your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Prophecy Fulfilled
cards.description: Whatever your first move is, that piece is named The Chosen One, purely cosmetically, forever, and you gain a draft reroll. Judged once, on your first move.

cards.name: Queen's Holiday
cards.description: Your queen puts on holiday sunglasses. This changes nothing at all. Free action.

cards.name: Quickstep
cards.description: Once, your king may move two squares sideways toward the h-file. Both squares must be empty, and your h-file rook must still stand in its corner. If unused by your 12th move, the charge becomes one draft reroll.

cards.name: Rabbit's Foot
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: gain a draft reroll. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Red Sky at Morning
cards.description: An omen flashes over the four center squares until your opponent replies, and you gain 3 seconds on your clock.

cards.name: Regina Dossier
cards.description: The first time the enemy queen moves, she is marked until you reply; since that mark changes no legal decision, you also gain a draft reroll and learn the tier of your next draft offer. One use.

cards.name: Regroup at Camp
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns on files c, d, e, f may step one square straight backward onto an empty square.

cards.name: Reserved Table
cards.description: Use once as a free action: put the brass sign on any empty square in your half except your back rank. Enemy pieces cannot end a move there for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Revolving Door
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns on files c, d, e, f may step one square diagonally forward onto an empty square. Not a capture.

cards.name: Ribbon Cutting
cards.description: The four center squares are ceremonially inaugurated with a flash. Nothing else happens.

cards.name: Ripe for Picking
cards.description: After your 5th move, every currently undefended enemy piece flashes until your opponent replies and loses any temporary shield.

cards.name: River Breakup
cards.description: After your 7th move, one of your central (files c through f) pawns with an empty square ahead advances one square at random. If none can, you gain 15 seconds (or 2 rerolls in untimed games) and it retries after each later move.

cards.name: Roll Call
cards.description: Your back-rank pieces flash as their names are read out. Nothing else happens.

cards.name: Rolling Gantry
cards.description: Once, one of your rooks may slide sideways along its rank passing through up to 1 friendly piece (never capturing them), landing beyond on an empty square; it cannot capture on landing.

cards.name: Roof Pigeon
cards.description: A pigeon settles on one of your rooks. This changes nothing at all. Free action; pick the rook.

cards.name: Royal Barter
cards.description: Use once as a free action: if your queen still stands on its home square (d1 for white) and your bishop on c1, they swap places.

cards.name: Rummage Sale
cards.description: Use once as a free action: if your bishop still stands on its home square (f1 for white) and your knight on g1, they swap places.

cards.name: Run for Eggs
cards.description: Use once as a free action: a pawn on files e, f, g, h advances one square immediately. The square ahead must be empty.

cards.name: Salt from the Coast
cards.description: Use once as a free action, from your 4th move on: an a- or h-file pawn hauls the barrel one square forward. The square ahead must be empty. The coast road is long.

cards.name: Sap Run
cards.description: After your 5th move, one of your d- or e-file pawns with an empty square ahead advances one square at random. If neither can, the tap still drips: you gain 8 seconds and one draft reroll.

cards.name: Second Harvest
cards.description: After your 12th move, gain a draft reroll.

cards.name: Second Thoughts
cards.description: Once, after your 6th move, one of your pawns on the d- or e-file may step one square straight backward onto an empty square.

cards.name: Water Break
cards.description: After your 8th move, gain 11 seconds, one draft reroll, and see the tier of your opponent's next draft offer.

cards.name: Servants' Entrance
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns on files a, b, c, d may step one square diagonally forward onto an empty square. Not a capture.

cards.name: Set Change
cards.description: Once, while on your back rank, one of your rooks may hop exactly 2 squares sideways along it, ignoring anything between. The destination must be empty. Scenery shifts between acts, so the hop waits for the first capture of the game.

cards.name: Sidestep and Bow
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may step one square diagonally backward onto an empty square.

cards.name: Siege Survey
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy queen and rook flashes on the board until your opponent replies, along with each of your pieces they are aimed at.

cards.name: Signal Rocket
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a launch of exactly 4 straight, clearing anything between. It may capture on landing. The leap becomes available only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Silk Curtain
cards.description: Your queen may hop over an adjacent friendly bishop on a diagonal, landing on the square directly beyond, once. The landing square must be empty.

cards.name: Smugglers' Lane
cards.description: Twice, your h-file pawn may advance two squares from wherever it stands. Both squares must be empty; it cannot capture this way. The second advance must start from a different square than the first.

cards.name: Snowdrop
cards.description: After your 6th move, two of your queenside (files a through d) pawns with an empty square ahead are rolled at random, and the one nearer promotion advances one square. If none can advance, you instead gain a draft reroll.

cards.name: Soup's On
cards.description: Use once as a free action: a pawn on files c, d, e, f advances one square immediately. The square ahead must be empty.

cards.name: Special Order
cards.description: Your next draft is dealt from tier 2.

cards.name: Spice Run
cards.description: Use once as a free action: a b- or g-file pawn still on its home square steps one square forward. The square ahead must be empty.

cards.name: Squire's Errand
cards.description: Twice, one of your pawns on the b- or g-file may step one square straight backward onto an empty square. The narrower district runs the errand twice. If the retreat is on offer on your turn but you play something else, the charge is spent.

cards.name: Stable Swap
cards.description: Use once as a free action: if your rook still stands on its home square (a1 for white) and your knight on b1, they swap places.

cards.name: Stage Left
cards.description: Once, while on your back rank, one of your knights may hop exactly 2 squares sideways along it, ignoring anything between. The destination must be empty. Taking this hop consumes your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Star Dressing Room
cards.description: Once, your queen may cross exactly 2 squares sideways along your back rank onto an empty square, ignoring whatever stands between. She waits for her cue: the walk is on offer only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Starboard Chart
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy piece on files e through h flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Stoppage Time
cards.description: When you make your first capture of the game, gain 9 seconds on your clock, advance one of your pawns one square, and gain a draft reroll. One use.

cards.name: Store Credit
cards.description: Gain one extra draft reroll.

cards.name: Sunday Best
cards.description: Your king puts on his good hat. This changes nothing at all. Free action.

cards.name: Tactical Withdrawal
cards.description: Once, a pawn of yours that an enemy piece is attacking may fall back one square onto the empty square behind it.

cards.name: Tango Dip
cards.description: Once, your king may move two squares diagonally forward toward the a-file. Both squares must be empty. After the dash resolves, gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Tea Leaves
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Team Photo
cards.description: Your whole army flashes for one commemorative photograph. Nothing else happens.

cards.name: The Management
cards.description: Your king is named The Management, purely cosmetically, forever.

cards.name: Threat Ledger
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy piece currently attacking one of your pieces flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Ticker Tape
cards.description: Each of your first 2 captures of the game, the square is showered in confetti until your opponent replies, and nothing else happens. The confetti falls only on a square not already showered. 2 uses.

cards.name: Title Deed
cards.description: After your 8th move, your castling rights are restored if you had lost them.

cards.name: Tower Bridge
cards.description: One of your rooks may hop over your other rook when adjacent on a rank or file, landing on the square directly beyond, once. The landing square must be empty. The hop becomes available only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Tower Torches
cards.description: For your next 4 turns, any enemy piece that ends a move next to one of your rooks is marked until you reply. The first time the patrol marks a piece, you gain a draft reroll.

cards.name: Town Square Sentry
cards.description: The first enemy piece to end a move on the four center squares is marked until you reply, every one of your pieces it could capture flashes, and you gain 5 seconds. One use.

cards.name: Towpath
cards.description: Once, your a-file or b-file pawn may advance two squares from wherever it stands. Both squares must be empty; it cannot capture this way.

cards.name: Transfer Window
cards.description: When you make your first capture of the game, gain a draft reroll. One use.

cards.name: Bishop's Hatch
cards.description: Once, while on your back rank, one of your bishops may hop exactly 2 squares sideways along it, passing over the one square between, which may hold a friendly piece. The destination must be empty.

cards.name: Tripwire Bell
cards.description: The first enemy piece to end a move in your half is marked until you reply, and you gain a draft reroll. One use.

cards.name: Understudy List
cards.description: The first time you give check, every enemy piece defending the enemy king's square flashes until your opponent replies; if none defends it you instead gain a draft reroll and learn the tier of your next draft offer. One use.

cards.name: Vaulting Horse
cards.description: One of your bishops may hop over an adjacent friendly knight on its diagonal, landing on the square directly beyond, once. The landing square must be empty. Taking this hop consumes your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Vizier's Errand
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a single step to an adjacent square, straight only. It may capture on landing. A turn where the leap is on offer but not taken spends one use.

cards.name: Walking Pace, Please
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, enemy pawns cannot make two-square moves.

cards.name: Wall Sentries
cards.description: For your next 6 turns, any enemy piece that ends a move on your back two ranks is marked until you reply. The first time the patrol marks a piece, you gain a draft reroll.

cards.name: Waltz Left
cards.description: Once, your king may glide two squares sideways toward the a-file across empty squares. The figure takes three counts: the glide waits until after your 3rd move. If unused by your 12th move, the charge becomes one draft reroll.

cards.name: Wet Floor Sign
cards.description: Use once as a free action: choose an empty square directly in front of one of your pawns. Enemy pieces cannot end a move there for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Window Washer
cards.description: Once, one of your bishops may slide along its diagonals passing through up to 1 friendly piece (never capturing them), landing beyond on an empty square; it cannot capture on landing.

cards.name: Wishbone
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: your next draft is dealt from tier 2. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Wrong Game Night
cards.description: One of your pawns arrives dressed for checkers. This changes nothing at all. Free action; pick the pawn.

cards.name: Zebra Crossing
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a zebra leap, 3 by 2, in any direction. Not a capture; the landing square must be empty.

cards.name: Backwards Hat
cards.description: One pawn may capture straight ahead on its next move.

cards.name: Checkmate Rehearsal
cards.description: Run the rehearsal, once: every enemy piece currently attacking one of your pieces is spotlighted, and the director's notes include one free draft reroll.

cards.name: Chess Boxing
cards.description: The kings put the gloves on: a 50/50 bout. The winner's player immediately gains one extra move.

cards.name: Coupon
cards.description: Clip it: gain one draft reroll. Thrifty shopper bonus: if you still hold an unused reroll when your third draft arrives, gain another.

cards.name: Fresh Socks
cards.description: Your next move flags the enemy piece that moved last until your opponent replies, and gives you one draft reroll. New socks, new you.

cards.name: Group Photo
cards.description: Snap a photo: every enemy piece that has moved at least once this game is marked, once.

cards.name: Growth Spurt
cards.description: One of your pawns becomes visibly enormous. This changes nothing at all.

cards.name: Kazoo Fanfare
cards.description: Your next capture is celebrated with a triumphant kazoo solo and confetti. Nothing else happens.

cards.name: Left Foot First
cards.description: Once, your king may lunge two squares toward the queenside if both squares are empty. Making the lunge spends your next unused draft reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Lucky Penny
cards.description: Pick a pawn and flip the coin: 50% heads, the pawn advances one square now (the jackpot); tails, it stays put and the failed flip is banked as two draft rerolls.

cards.name: Manager's Challenge
cards.description: Challenge your opponent's last move: 50% their piece is marched back to the square it came from (if free) and stunned for 1 turn; 50% the call goes against you and your own last-moved piece is stunned for 1 turn.

cards.name: Mirror Shield
cards.description: The next time one of your knights or bishops is captured, the shield flashes back and removes a random enemy pawn. If they have no pawns, it keeps waiting.

cards.name: Name Tag
cards.description: Stick a name tag on one enemy piece. It is Gary now. Whichever of your pieces takes Gary cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Nightlight
cards.description: A little lamp clicks on: enemy knights cannot end a move next to your king for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Pebble Toss
cards.description: Choose an unmoved enemy pawn; it loses its two-square first move on your opponent's next turn. The pebble is spent after that turn even if the pawn stays put.

cards.name: Pet Rock
cards.description: One of your pawns cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn. The rock is watching.

cards.name: Pigeon Post
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, every enemy piece attacking your queen is marked by a landing pigeon and loses any temporary shield covering it.

cards.name: Polite Cough
cards.description: Ahem. Steal 10 seconds from your opponent's clock, flag the enemy piece that moved last until your opponent replies, and gain one draft reroll. In untimed games only the flag and the reroll apply.

cards.name: Prank Call
cards.description: Ring ring: your opponent takes a very important call and loses 5 seconds.

cards.name: Rain Check
cards.description: In 5 of your turns, the cloud pays out: one draft reroll, and a look at the tier of your opponent's next draft.

cards.name: Spare Button
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, if you lose a pawn, a fresh one is stitched onto its file's home square if that square is empty. One use.

cards.name: Squeaky Shoes
cards.description: For 5 of your turns, any enemy piece that ends a move next to your king squeaks and is marked. The first time one squeaks, gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Static Cling
cards.description: The enemy piece that moved last is stuck fast and cannot move on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Sugar Glider
cards.description: One knight's next move may be a (2,2) diagonal glide instead.

cards.name: Tiny Trebuchet
cards.description: Launch one of your pawns two squares straight ahead, once. Both squares must be empty; no capturing on landing. It arms only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Warm-Up Stretch
cards.description: One knight's next move may be a long camel leap (3,1) instead. When it makes the leap, gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Wet Paint
cards.description: Choose a square; enemy pieces cannot end their move on it for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Window Shopping
cards.description: You know exactly which shelf you want: your next draft is dealt from tier 2, and once you have seen it you gain one reroll.

cards.name: Peek
cards.description: See your opponent's next draft offer.

cards.name: Quiet March
cards.description: One pawn can move backward one square, once. It cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Reprieve
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 2 turns, beginning after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Rook Slide
cards.description: One rook moves one square diagonally, twice.

cards.name: Royal Restraint
cards.description: Your opponent's king cannot capture for their next 4 turns, though it may make one capture to escape.

cards.name: Sentinel Pawn
cards.description: One pawn may capture an enemy piece two squares diagonally ahead, twice.

cards.name: Slippery Grip
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, their rooks slide at most 3 squares for their following 4 turns.

cards.name: Snap Freeze
cards.description: Freeze the piece that last moved for 1 of its turns.

cards.name: Promotion Anxiety
cards.description: Your opponent's first pawn promotion within their next 4 turns is held back one of their turns; the poised pawn stays on its seventh rank. Promotions after the first go through.

cards.name: Steady March
cards.description: Two pawns each advance one square immediately.

cards.name: Stiff Joints
cards.description: Your opponent's queen cannot move diagonally for their next 3 turns, though it may make one diagonal move to escape.

cards.name: Stream Sniper
cards.description: You found their stream: see your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and your own next draft shows three cards to pick from.

cards.name: Teleport Knight
cards.description: Move one knight to any empty square within the 3x3 box around it, once. It cannot capture with this move.

cards.name: Tempo Shuffle
cards.description: Move one pawn sideways one square, once. Gain one draft reroll when it resolves.

cards.name: Third Eye
cards.description: Your third eye opens onto what is still hidden: see your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Toll Gate
cards.description: Your opponent cannot capture en passant for their next 5 turns.

cards.name: Vault
cards.description: One rook jumps its own pawn to the far side, twice.

cards.name: Stone the Pawns
cards.description: For their next 3 turns your opponent's pawns cannot make two-square advances.

cards.name: Walnut Shell
cards.description: Crack it open: free one of your pieces from any freeze or walnut hex. If none of your pieces is stuck, eat the nut instead: gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Watchtower
cards.description: The tower spots the cavalry a mile out: enemy knights cannot move into your half of the board, except to capture, for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Quicksand Patch
cards.description: For their next 2 turns your opponent's pawns cannot make two-square advances.

cards.name: Thunder Step
cards.description: One rook may move up to two squares diagonally, once.

cards.name: Updraft
cards.description: One knight may make a longer 3-by-1 leap, once; after the leap, gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Anchor
cards.description: Choose one piece; after your opponent's next move it can no longer be pushed or swapped by enemy buffs, for the game.

cards.name: Apple
cards.description: Feed one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns and may immediately step one square to an empty square beside it.

cards.name: Banana Peel
cards.description: Toss peels on two empty squares, visible to both players. The first enemy piece other than the king to step on each slips one square back toward its home rank and is too dazed to move on its owner's next turn.

cards.name: Battle Pass
cards.description: Season rewards trickle in: at the end of each of your next 6 turns, your clock gains 10 seconds.

cards.name: Blunted Lance
cards.description: Your opponent's knights cannot land on any square defended by one of your pawns, for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Angelus Bell
cards.description: Every 5th move you make, the bell tolls: your nerf is suspended for your next turn. Lasts the rest of the game. In exchange, your next 2 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: Bartered Calm
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, your nerf is suspended for your next 4 turns. In exchange, your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Bottled Courage
cards.description: Uncork it: your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, and every piece of yours standing beside him cannot be captured for those 2 turns either.

cards.name: Boundary Stones
cards.description: Mark 2 empty squares in your half: no enemy piece may move onto them for 4 turns.

cards.name: Cold Compress
cards.description: The next 2 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns, beginning after your opponent's following move.

cards.name: Confetti Cannon
cards.description: One of your pieces (your king excepted) puts on sunglasses for the rest of the game (purely decorative) and struts uncapturable through your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Coupon Book
cards.description: Your next draft offer rolls one tier higher. The redemption fee is one of your rerolls, if you have any.

cards.name: Crowned Strider
cards.description: For your next 4 turns, your king may move two squares in a straight line, if both squares are empty.

cards.name: Day Laborer
cards.description: Place a pawn on an empty square in your half. It works 5 of your turns, then leaves the board.

cards.name: Dowager's Patience
cards.description: While your opponent has a queen on the board and you do not, your nerf is suspended, beginning the turn after each of your opponent's moves.

cards.name: Ear to the Ground
cards.description: Learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer, and gain 1 draft reroll. If that draft is already skipped, only the reroll arrives.

cards.name: Egg Timer
cards.description: Add 20 seconds to your clock, gain 1 draft reroll, and learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer. In untimed games only the reroll and the reveal apply.

cards.name: Field Stitches
cards.description: Return one of your captured pawns to an empty square on your second rank.

cards.name: Gate Key
cards.description: Once, one of your rooks may step a single square diagonally (capturing allowed). The square it lands on lights up until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Half Step Back
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may retreat one square straight back onto an empty square (never onto your back rank).

cards.name: Hearth Ring
cards.description: Every one of your pieces standing beside your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Herald's Truce
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces (your king excepted): for your opponent's next turn it cannot be captured and your king cannot be taken.

cards.name: Hourglass Flip
cards.description: Add 30 seconds to your clock. In untimed games it adds nothing.

cards.name: Kettle On
cards.description: Put the kettle on: every one of your frozen or stuck pieces thaws at once.

cards.name: Knight's Vigil
cards.description: The next 3 times you move a knight, your nerf is suspended for one of your turns, beginning after your opponent's following move.

cards.name: Measured Breath
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next turn and gain 1 draft reroll, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Militia Call
cards.description: Place a new pawn on an empty square on your second rank.

cards.name: Parade Polish
cards.description: Gild one of your pieces (your king excepted): it wears the shine for the rest of the game and cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Party Hat
cards.description: Put a party hat on any piece on the board, forever (purely decorative). If it is one of yours, it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns: nobody ruins a party.

cards.name: Pawn's Lullaby
cards.description: The next 2 times you move a pawn, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

cards.name: Pocket Shield
cards.description: One of your pieces (your king excepted) cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Royal Stroll
cards.description: For your next turn, your king may move two squares in a straight line, if both squares are empty.

cards.name: Rubber Duck
cards.description: One of your pieces (your king excepted) becomes delightfully plush for the rest of the game (purely decorative) and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Saint's Day
cards.description: After your next 4 turns, your nerf is suspended for the 4 turns that follow. On the final turn the relief applies only to movement restrictions: you may move only one square at a time.

cards.name: Sleepy Dust
cards.description: Sprinkle sleep over one enemy piece (their king excepted). After your opponent's next move, it dozes through their following turn. If they move the marked piece first, the sleep follows it.

cards.name: Slipped Collar
cards.description: The first time your opponent captures your queen, your nerf is suspended for your next 8 turns.

cards.name: Slow Doors
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 2 turns, though they may still capture.

cards.name: Spare Button
cards.description: A pawn slips into your pocket, ready to be dropped onto an empty square on a later turn (the drop spends that turn).

cards.name: Spring in the Step
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 2 turns, and your most advanced pawn immediately steps one square forward if the way is clear. On the second of those turns the relief applies only to movement restrictions: you may move only one square at a time.

cards.name: Steady Hands
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next turn, and none of your pawns can be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Stowaway
cards.description: After your next 5 turns, a pawn is discovered aboard and joins your pocket, ready to drop on a later turn.

cards.name: Third Wind
cards.description: After your next 6 turns, your nerf is suspended for the 3 turns that follow.

cards.name: Thorn Hedge
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their knights cannot move into your half of the board, except to capture.

cards.name: Trophy Rest
cards.description: The next 2 times you capture a knight, bishop, rook or queen, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

cards.name: Understudy
cards.description: The first time one of your pawns is captured, a fresh pawn joins your pocket, ready to drop on a later turn.

cards.name: Window Shopping
cards.description: See the cards in your opponent's next draft offer.

cards.name: Bubble Wrap
cards.description: Shrink-wrap one of your own pieces: it cannot be captured for 3 turns, but it can only move for the last of them. Your king cannot be chosen.

cards.name: Bulwark
cards.description: Two pawns in front of your king cannot be captured for 3 turns.

cards.name: Butter Bishops
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, their bishops slide at most 2 squares for their following 4 turns.

cards.name: Buzzer Beater
cards.description: Steal a buzzer-beating 20 seconds off your opponent's clock and put it on yours.

cards.name: Cornered King
cards.description: Desperation teaches strange footwork: once, while you have fewer pieces than your opponent (kings aside), your king may move like a knight.

cards.name: Divine Right
cards.description: No peasant may slay a king: enemy pawns can never capture your king, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Scarecrow
cards.description: Prop a scarecrow on an empty square in your half: it stands there as one of your pawns but is rooted and can never move, for the rest of the game. It blocks lines for both sides and can be captured like any pawn.

cards.name: Bishop's Blessing
cards.description: The clergy is above the cavalry's reach: enemy knights can never capture your bishops, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Coronation Bonus
cards.description: The crowning is worth a stolen hour: the first time one of your pawns promotes, you gain 30 seconds on your clock. In untimed games it grants nothing.

cards.name: Rally to the King
cards.description: Call the nearest blade home: teleport any one of your pieces (your king aside) to an empty square directly adjacent to your king.

cards.name: Castle Early
cards.description: Castle even if your king or rooks have already moved. When you next castle, your king cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Chill Guy
cards.description: He's just a chill guy: every freeze and every walnut currently stuck to YOUR pieces melts off. A free action. Lowkey he doesn't even care.

cards.name: Coconut Bonk
cards.description: Drop a coconut on one enemy piece: it is stunned and cannot move for its next turn. Kings are too hard-headed.

cards.name: Computer Virus
cards.description: Upload a virus to your opponent's clock. At the end of each of their next 5 turns it drains 8 seconds from their time. The clock floor still stops it from flagging them instantly.

cards.name: Cornerstone
cards.description: Your rooks cannot be captured while they stand on your back rank, for the game.

cards.name: Crossed Wires
cards.description: Your opponent's knights cannot capture for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Let It Ride
cards.description: Flip a coin and let your winnings ride. Each heads bumps the prize and flips again, up to three. One heads pays 40 seconds, two a knight in your pocket, three a knight and a bishop plus 20 seconds. Tails first loses the ante, your weakest pawn.

cards.name: Cut Purse
cards.description: Steal one of your opponent's unspent cards of tier 1, then take a draft reroll. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: Deadline
cards.description: Every deliverable now costs overtime: your opponent's next 3 captures each cost them 15 seconds off the clock.

cards.name: Defiance
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf until your opponent's next capture, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Draft Insight
cards.description: Your next draft is fated to offer tier 3 cards.

cards.name: Emotional Support Pawn
cards.description: A small round friend refuses to leave your side: place a new pawn on an empty square right beside your king.

cards.name: Evil Eye
cards.description: One enemy piece you choose cannot capture anything for 4 of their turns. It may still move. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Fey Step
cards.description: One of your knights or bishops slips into the hedgerow and steps out behind their lines: move it to any empty square on your opponent's back two ranks, once. The step lands on an empty square only and cannot capture.

cards.name: Firecracker
cards.description: Startle one enemy piece (not the king): it retreats one square toward its home rank and is too rattled to move on its owner's next turn.

cards.name: Firm Footing
cards.description: Choose one piece: it and your pawns on the squares beside it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Fly Swatter
cards.description: One enemy knight is stunned for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Hearthbread
cards.description: Choose an empty square on your first two ranks. A new pawn appears there.

cards.name: Fogbank
cards.description: Your opponent's bishops cannot move more than 2 squares for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Moonlit Stride
cards.description: For your next 3 turns each of your knights may also step one square straight up, down or sideways.

cards.name: Fortress
cards.description: One piece standing next to your king becomes uncapturable for your opponent's next 4 turns. Your king itself is not shielded.

cards.name: Free Retreat
cards.description: Return your last-moved piece to the square it came from, once.

cards.name: Card Counting
cards.description: Three draws, 55% each, streak ends on a miss: one hit and a random pawn sidesteps; two hits and a random pawn also advances; three hits and a fresh pawn joins your second rank.

cards.name: Double Down Draft
cards.description: Push your chips in, half and half: 50% you take BOTH cards of your next draft, 50% your next draft is skipped entirely while the dealer smiles.

cards.name: Hardship Jackpot
cards.description: The misery meter pays out: 60% a pawn appears on your second rank, 25% one of your frozen or stuck pieces is thawed, 15% the jackpot doubles: a pawn AND a thaw.

cards.name: Rigged Raffle
cards.description: Enter your opponent in a raffle they never asked to join: their next move passes untouched, then for their following 3 turns, 1 chance in 3 after each of their moves that the piece they just moved is glued in place for a turn.

cards.name: Three-Card Monte
