cards.description: Your king walks between heartbeats: it may also leap like a knight to an empty square, for the rest of the game. The leap cannot capture.

cards.name: Grand Retreat
cards.description: Return your army to its free starting squares, once (blocked pieces stay put).

cards.name: Grand Summon
cards.description: Add a knight and a bishop to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns; your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Gravity Well
cards.description: Your king bends space around it: enemy pieces standing within one square of your king are caught in orbit and cannot move to a square farther from it. Enemy kings are not affected.

cards.name: Griffon Rider
cards.description: Move up to two of your pieces to any empty squares, once.

cards.name: Grounded Command
cards.description: The heavy pieces are grounded: for your opponent's next 4 turns a queen or rook still in their own half cannot move onto any square in your half. One already standing in your half moves freely.

cards.name: Groundhog Day
cards.description: Whichever piece your opponent moves on their next turn is caught in a loop. Their turn after that is one free escape, but on the turn after it they must move that same piece again. If that piece can no longer move, the loop is skipped.

cards.name: Guardian Angel
cards.description: Twice per game, when your opponent captures one of your pieces (not your king), it is spirited to safety instead: an identical piece reappears on an empty square deep in your half. It cannot move, so cannot capture, until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Home Field
cards.description: Home advantage: while standing in your own half of the board or one rank past it, each of your knights, bishops, and rooks may also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: Beacon of Woe
cards.description: Light a doom-beacon on one of your OWN pieces, in full view. When your opponent's 6th turn from now ends, every enemy knight, bishop, rook and queen is frozen for 2 of their turns. If they capture the beacon-bearer first, the curse dies with it.

cards.name: Chains of the Court
cards.description: Your opponent's knights and bishops are petrified into walnuts for 4 of their turns, shuffling one square at a time. The chains have a lock: if their king steps onto one of the four centre squares, every petrified courtier is freed at once.

cards.name: Gathering Storm
cards.description: Their next move is clear, then the storm worsens every two turns across their following 6. Turns 1-2: their pawns cannot advance, captures still fine. Turns 3-4: knights and bishops also cannot cross into your half. Turns 5-6: long pieces capped at 2 squares.

cards.name: Gilded Rot
cards.description: Their next move passes untouched, then for their following 5 turns each piece they move is gilded, and a gilded piece cannot capture for the rest of the curse. When the curse ends the gold flakes off everything at once.

cards.name: Gravebloom
cards.description: Their next move passes untouched, then for their following 6 turns every square where they capture becomes a grave-garden for 3 of their turns: the capturing piece may leave, but no enemy piece may move onto that square while it blooms.

cards.name: Pauper's Crown
cards.description: Their queen becomes a rook for 4 of their turns, or until she captures. If she is taken while a rook, she is lost as a rook.

cards.name: Avalanche
cards.description: Snow gathers over their half for 3 of their turns, then falls. For the 3 turns after, their pieces may only capture or move into your half, never onto an empty square at home. The first piece they move once it falls gets one escape onto open ground.

cards.name: Sleeper Cell
cards.description: Plant a sleeper in one enemy knight or bishop. On their 3rd turn from now it wakes and defects: yours to command for your next 3 turns, then it slips back. Until it turns it is still theirs. Kings are never turned.

cards.name: Effigy of Dread
cards.description: Raise a leering effigy on an empty square in your opponent's half. No enemy piece may step onto the ring around it, though a piece already inside may leave. It stands 6 of their turns, and it is a piece they can capture: smashing it ends the curse.

cards.name: The Inverted Crown
cards.description: For your opponent's next 6 turns, any pawn that reaches the last rank is crowned a mere knight, no matter what they choose to promote to.

cards.name: Powder Keg
cards.description: Roll a powder keg onto an empty square in your opponent's half with a lit 4-turn fuse, in full view. When it blows, every enemy piece except the king standing on or next to that square is blown off the board, and you gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Avalanche Pass
cards.description: Snow buries both central files: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on the d or e file for their next 2 turns, while yours climb freely. Pieces already standing there may leave freely.

cards.name: Black Lotus
cards.description: The lotus blooms once over their army: one random pawn, knight, bishop, rook and queen of theirs (one of each they still have) is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Chain Gang
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, every piece they own may move at most 1 square, except their single most valuable piece, which the chains spare. King captures are always allowed.

cards.name: Checkers Law
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, if any capture is available to them, they must play a capture. The old rules apply.

cards.name: Dead Calm
cards.description: The wind dies: for your opponent's next 2 turns, their bishops, rooks and queen may slide at most 1 square. The first piece the calm would rein in may slide freely once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Dead March
cards.description: For your opponent's next 6 turns, the drums forbid haste: on every second turn (the 2nd, 4th and 6th) their rooks and queen cannot move.

cards.name: Debt Collector
cards.description: The collector holds off for one move, then watches for 5 of your opponent's turns: their second capture in that window makes the capturing piece a walnut for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Dockmaster's Fee
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every capture they make is taxed: on the turn after a capture they may only move a pawn or their king. The first piece the tax would hold back may make one move regardless, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Frozen Reserves
cards.description: The reserves never got the mobilization order: every enemy piece standing on their own back rank, except pawns and the king, is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Gorgon's Court
cards.description: Choose 2 enemy pieces (never the king): both become walnuts for 3 of their turns. The first piece chosen may make one move before it petrifies.

cards.name: Grave Chill
cards.description: A chill rises from below: every enemy piece standing on a dark square is frozen for 1 of their turns. Their king shivers but stays free.

cards.name: Hall of Mirrors
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, every piece must land on a square of the same color it started from. Knights, whose every leap changes color, cannot move at all. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Hunter's Moon
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, any piece of theirs that captures is cursed by the moon and becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns. Kings are beyond the curse.

cards.name: Iron Maiden
cards.description: Clamp one enemy rook or queen you target in iron. After your opponent's next move, it is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Ivory Tower
cards.description: Your opponent's next move passes freely. Then, for their next 4 turns, their king may not move toward your side of the board. Sideways and homeward steps are free.

cards.name: The Old Laws
cards.description: The ancient rulebook is enforced: for your opponent's next 4 turns there is no castling, no two square pawn advance, and no en passant. The first piece the old law would forbid may make one such move, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Pied Piper
cards.description: Your opponent's next move passes freely. Then the pipe plays and the infantry follows: for their next 2 turns, if any pawn move is available they must move a pawn.

cards.name: Pillory
cards.description: Lock one enemy piece you target in the pillory: it wears the dunce cap for 6 of their turns, and after it makes one move it is frozen for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be locked up.

cards.name: Prowler's Bell
cards.description: A bell is tied to every gate in your half: for your opponent's next 3 turns, their pieces may not end a move on an EMPTY square in your half. They may enter only by capturing. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Quagmire March
cards.description: Your half of the board turns to bog: your opponent's next move passes freely, then for their following 3 turns, any piece of theirs standing in your half may move at most 1 square. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Reaper's Due
cards.description: The reaper collects from the front line: your opponent's 3 most advanced pieces (never the king) are frozen for 2 of their turns. The most advanced of them may make one move before it freezes.

cards.name: Sealed Meridian
cards.description: Choose a file: for 2 of your opponent's turns none of their pieces may cross it, though they may move along it, stop on it, or leave it. Your pieces pass freely.

cards.name: Signal Jam
cards.description: Your opponent's next move passes freely, then for their following 3 turns, none of their pieces may end a move on the same file as their own king. The king itself may move freely.

cards.name: Siren Song
cards.description: Mark one enemy piece: for your opponent's next 2 turns, every move it makes must bring it closer to your king. The rest of their army is free. Kings cannot be marked.

cards.name: Sleepwalkers
cards.description: Your opponent's next move passes freely, then for their following 3 turns, pieces that start a move in their own half cannot capture. Only their pieces already in your half may fight.

cards.name: Spider's Parlor
cards.description: Invisible webs stretch between the armies: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that ends a move adjacent to one of your pieces is snared and frozen for 1 of their turns. Kings tear free.

cards.name: The Walnut Crown
cards.description: Your opponent's queen becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns: the mightiest piece on the board reduced to a slow, dignified shuffle.

cards.name: Walnut Pinch
cards.description: Your opponent's queen turns into a walnut for 1 of their turns: a heavy nut that can only shuffle one square.

cards.name: Wax Seal
cards.description: Their supply lines are sealed: your opponent's next drafted card arrives nullified, and their next offer excludes draft manipulation cards.

cards.name: White Flag Hour
cards.description: A rolling truce is called: on the 1st and 3rd of your opponent's next 4 turns, they cannot capture anything.

cards.name: I Love NewJeans
cards.description: Harmony: for the game, every non-king piece of yours that stands next to a friendly piece may also step one square in any direction onto an empty square, but this step cannot capture.

cards.name: I Love Making Out
cards.description: Bond two of your pieces for the game. Each also moves the way the other does, blending a knight with a bishop or a rook with a queen, but these borrowed moves cannot capture.

cards.name: Jackpot
cards.description: Pull the lever for a one-in-two shot at a random apex card, one of the game's most powerful. Miss, and the consolation is still rich: your next draft rolls one tier higher and offers three cards instead of two.

cards.name: Kraken
cards.description: A kraken surfaces on an empty square. For your opponent's next 2 turns, at the end of each of their turns it drags the nearest enemy piece one square toward it when the square between is empty, then seizes any enemy piece beside it so it cannot move next turn.

cards.name: Leaden Fields
cards.description: Their pawns are cast in lead: every advanced enemy pawn first sinks one square back toward home (if that square is free), and then their pawns cannot move at all, not even to capture, for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Lich Phylactery
cards.description: The first time your queen is captured, a new queen appears on her home square, or on the nearest empty square of your back rank if her home is taken.

cards.name: Lightning Strike
cards.description: Mark up to three enemy knights, bishops, or pawns; after your opponent's next move, lightning falls and removes each marked piece that still stands.

cards.name: Long Leash
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 7 turns.

cards.name: Lost Days
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn entirely. On the turn after that, they may move only pawns, knights, or their king.

cards.name: Loyal Pawn
cards.description: Once, a pawn stepping onto your 7th rank may promote there instead of the 8th. The new piece cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Lunar Eclipse
cards.description: The moon slides into shadow and the enemy's great powers still with it: your opponent's rooks and queen cannot move for 3 of their turns, though the first of them may slip away with one move before the shadow takes it.

cards.name: Mass Resurrect
cards.description: Revive any four captured pawns to empty squares on your 2nd rank.

cards.name: Minefield
cards.description: Seed three mines on empty squares. The first enemy piece, never a king, to step on each mine is destroyed, and the blast removes every enemy piece except kings on the 8 squares around it. Shielded pieces resist the blast.

cards.name: Nerf Breaker
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 10 turns.

cards.name: Nerf Hammer
cards.description: Bring down the nerf hammer: turn one enemy knight, bishop, or rook you target into a walnut for 2 of their turns. It can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Nerf This
cards.description: The balance team finally answers: one enemy queen you point at is patched down to a bishop where she stands. The defender keeps one queen immune, so a lone queen shrugs the patch off.

cards.name: Nova
cards.description: Sacrifice one pawn to clear every enemy piece except the king from its file, once.

cards.name: Onslaught
cards.description: The whole army surges: for your next 3 turns, every one of your knights, bishops, rooks, and queens can also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: Cloud Serpent
cards.description: A serpent coils a chosen rank: enemy pieces cannot enter or cross it for your opponent's next 5 turns (yours can). As it lands it may crush one enemy pawn on an adjacent rank.

cards.name: Colossal Visitor
cards.description: A colossal lizard crosses a chosen file: every pawn on it is trampled, every other piece (kings excluded) is shoved one file aside where empty, and two random empty squares of the file smolder: your opponent cannot enter them for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Democracy
cards.description: Parliament sits for 3 of your turns. After each of your moves the house votes: usually applause worth 8 seconds, sometimes a motion that marches a random pawn of yours forward, occasionally a filibuster where nothing happens at all.

cards.name: Frost Wyrm
cards.description: An ice dragon sweeps a chosen rank: every enemy piece on it (king excluded) is frozen for 2 turns, and its empty squares become ice walls your opponent cannot enter for their next turn.

cards.name: Grail Quest
cards.description: Send one of your knights away on quest. After 5 of your turns it returns to a random empty square in your half as a Grail Knight, permanently able to also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: Grand Illusionist
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they cannot capture your knights or bishops, and using it spends one of your unused draft rerolls if you have any. Which one was the real one again?

cards.name: The Great Flood
cards.description: A wave washes every piece on the central four ranks (kings excluded) one square toward its own back rank, where that square is empty. Blocked pieces stay.

cards.name: Heavenly Bureaucracy
cards.description: Once within your next 8 turns: when an enemy move puts your king in check, the check is misfiled and your king is relocated to a random empty square that is not attacked. If no safe square exists, the filing stands.

cards.name: High Water Mark
cards.description: The middle two ranks flood: for your opponent's next 3 turns their bishops, rooks and queens cannot move through them, only into them.

cards.name: Hostile Takeover
cards.description: Spend your turn issuing the order: name one enemy piece (not their king) and any square it could legally reach without capturing. After your opponent's next move it is reassigned there, if the piece still stands and the square is still empty.

cards.name: Locust Swarm
cards.description: Choose a rank: every pawn on it, yours and theirs, is devoured.

cards.name: Meteor Golf
cards.description: Tee off at any square, in plain sight of both players. Until it lands, the target and its adjacent squares are sealed against your opponent. After their next move the meteor strikes: any piece on the target, kings excluded, is destroyed and the seal lifts.

cards.name: NerfChess: The Musical
cards.description: The whole board takes the stage, once: rearrange up to five of your pieces onto empty squares in your half, then collect 10 seconds for putting on a show.

cards.name: Puppeteer's Gala
cards.description: Pull the strings: move up to two different enemy minor pieces yourself, each along its own normal non-capture moves, onto empty squares.

cards.name: Royal Food Taster
cards.description: Place a Taster pawn on an empty square next to your queen. The next time your queen is captured, the Taster dies in her place and your queen returns on the Taster's square.

cards.name: Standing Ovation
cards.description: An audience gathers for 5 of your turns: each of your moves that leaves the enemy king under attack earns 10 seconds of applause.

cards.name: The Tutorial
cards.description: A relentlessly cheerful tutorial haunts your opponent for their next 3 turns: every enemy move is marked and reviewed, and whenever their moved piece ends up hanging you are paid 8 seconds while it congratulates them.

cards.name: Volcanic Vent
cards.description: Open a vent on an empty square for 9 of your turns. Every 3rd of your turns it erupts: pawns of both sides adjacent to it are destroyed, and other adjacent pieces except kings are pushed one square outward if the square is free.

cards.name: Wish Fish
cards.description: Reel it in and take the wish it grants: 30 seconds on your clock, a new pawn beside your king, or 2 draft rerolls. The fish decides.

cards.name: Overwhelm
cards.description: Take two moves in a row, once. You cannot capture the king during these bonus moves: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Parole
cards.description: Your nerf is removed for good after your next 10 turns.

cards.name: Promotion Storm
cards.description: All pawns on your 5th rank or beyond promote to knights.

cards.name: Purge Realm
cards.description: Remove every enemy minor piece from one half of the board.

cards.name: Purge Storm
cards.description: Remove three enemy pawns and freeze the rest for 1 turn.

cards.name: Queen's Wrath
cards.description: In one move, your queen slides along one straight line to an empty square without capturing, then freezes every enemy piece beside her landing square for their next turn; the line stops at the first piece of either color, once.

cards.name: RGB Keyboard
cards.description: Light up every key. For the game your knights add a 1-square step any direction, your bishops slide 2 straight, and your rooks slide 2 diagonally, but these added moves cannot capture.

cards.name: Rift Storm
cards.description: Teleport up to two of your pieces, your king aside, each to any empty square, then swap the squares of two enemy pieces caught in the churn, once.

cards.name: Royal Ascension
cards.description: Your king gains queen movement permanently, but its added long-range moves cannot capture; it still captures as a normal king (and still loses on capture).

cards.name: Royal Summons
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they must move their king if it has a legal move.

cards.name: Rust
cards.description: Idle enemy pieces seize up: any enemy piece (never a king) that has stood still for 2 of your opponent's turns rusts solid and may only move if the move is a capture, until it finally moves.

cards.name: Sealed Avenues
cards.description: Your opponent cannot enter any square on the d or e files for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Second King
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns, on any rank; after your opponent's next move it becomes a second king. Your opponent must capture both of your kings to win.

cards.name: Serpent Brood
cards.description: Venomous stone serpents coil around the enemy clergy: every one of your opponent's bishops turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and the venom lingers so no enemy bishop may capture for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Sinkhole
cards.description: The earth chooses where to open: three sinkholes appear on random empty squares in your opponent's half. Any enemy piece except a king that steps onto one plunges out of the game. They stay open the rest of the match.

cards.name: Statue Garden
cards.description: Your opponent's knights and bishops turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, shuffling one square at a time. The first one struck petrifies only after your opponent's next move, and escapes if they move it away.

cards.name: Stone Bastions
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns, and each stone bastion seals its ground: for their next 2 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto the files their petrified rooks stand on.

cards.name: Stone Riders
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, their knights turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, and the stone is catching: on each of those turns one random enemy piece standing beside a stone rider is petrified for 1 turn too.

cards.name: Sundering
cards.description: Choose three files: each is barred to your opponent until the end of their next turn, then collapses.

cards.name: The Big Chill
cards.description: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for one of their turns. As the ice lets go, two random survivors turn to walnuts, able to shuffle only one square at a time, for one more of their turns.

cards.name: Thorn Hedge
cards.description: A hedge of black thorns walls off your realm: enemy bishops, rooks, and queens cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Time Lock
cards.description: Lock your opponent's clock and hand: they skip their next turn, and their next draft is skipped, once.

cards.name: Time Skip
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn, and the piece they last moved is frozen for their next 2 turns. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Time Stop (Short)
cards.description: Time stops: freeze every enemy piece except the king for 1 turn, then take one extra move right now, once. You cannot capture the king during the bonus move: your opponent replies first. Afterward your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Total Nullify
cards.description: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs. Locked-in piece upgrades resist. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
cards.description: The drum-man marches on your opponent's king. On each of your next 5 turns, the two enemy pieces nearest their king are bonked and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Kings are too stubborn to bonk.

cards.name: Union Rules
cards.description: Your pieces get mandated rest: for your opponent's next 2 turns after they capture one of your pieces, they cannot make a capture. If capturing is their only legal option, the rule is waived for that turn.

cards.name: Unseelie Bargain
cards.description: Free action: strike a bargain with the dark court and take two extra moves right now. When the sequence resolves the price comes due and you skip your next draft.

cards.name: Valkyrie
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any knight, bishop, or rook of yours they capture is carried home to your pocket instead of being lost for good. Drop it back onto an empty square on a later turn. In exchange, you skip your next draft.

cards.name: Void
cards.description: The void takes one enemy pawn, knight, or bishop, and the square it stood on stays a void that swallows any enemy piece except a king that enters it, for the game; the defender gets one bridge, so the first enemy piece to enter crosses it safely.

cards.name: Frozen Moment
cards.description: Seal this moment in glass: choose one enemy piece except a king. After 3 of their turns, wherever it has run to, it is snapped back to the square it stands on right now (if that square is free again).

cards.name: Leaden Crown
cards.description: Turn one of your pawns into a queen, and the leaden crown guards it: that new queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Royal Aegis
cards.description: Your king and your queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Wall of Thorns
cards.description: A thicket of thorns bursts up around one of your pieces: the up to 8 squares surrounding it are barred to your opponent for 3 of their turns. If your opponent captures that piece, the wall of thorns falls at once.

cards.name: Walnut Curse
cards.description: Their greed turns to wood: for your opponent's next 2 captures, the capturing piece becomes a walnut for 3 of their turns, able only to shuffle one square at a time. Kings shrug the curse off.

cards.name: Warp Cataclysm
cards.description: Teleport up to four of your pieces, your king aside, each to any empty square, once. Pawns stay off the first and last ranks.

cards.name: Clown Car
cards.description: Two knights pile out of one tiny car: place them on two empty squares that touch each other. Both are too dizzy to move on your next turn.

cards.name: Concrete Shoes
cards.description: Fit one of your opponent's rooks or queens with concrete shoes: it cannot move at all for their next 3 turns, then it hardens into a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for the rest of the game. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Wrecking Ball
cards.description: Your queen winds up a full swing: after your opponent's next move, every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around her is smashed off the board. Shielded pieces resist the swing, once.

cards.name: Conflagration
cards.description: Remove two enemy pieces, each a pawn, knight, or bishop, once.

cards.name: Flash Freeze
cards.description: After your opponent replies, freeze every enemy piece standing next to your king for their next 2 turns and bonk it where it stands.

cards.name: Flood
cards.description: Three floodwaters spread over empty squares: the first enemy piece to step onto one with a non-capturing move (never a king) is swept off the board. A piece that captures its way onto the water is not swept. They stay for 2 of your turns.

cards.name: Frost Ward
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Every enemy piece that ends a move next to your king in that time is frozen for 1 turn and bonked where it stands.

cards.name: Glacier Wall
cards.description: Two walls of ice rise: pick any two squares, and every empty square on each of their files becomes impassable to your opponent for their next 2 turns. Any enemy piece already standing on a frozen file may leave normally.

cards.name: Hellfire Beam
cards.description: The beam scorches one diagonal: pick a square and choose one of the two diagonals through it. Every empty square along it burns: your opponent cannot move onto them for their next 2 turns. Any enemy piece already on the diagonal may leave normally.

cards.name: Immolation
cards.description: Offer one of your own pawns to the flame: it is consumed, and the blast removes up to seven enemy pieces (never kings) on the 8 squares around it. If all eight squares hold enemies, one is spared. Shielded pieces resist the fire.

cards.name: Quagmire
cards.description: Open two patches of sucking mud on empty squares: any enemy piece except a king that steps onto one is stuck fast for its next 3 turns instead of removed. The mud stays for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Rooted
cards.description: Roots seize the heavy pieces: your opponent's rooks and queen cannot move for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Scorch
cards.description: Remove one enemy knight or bishop from the board; the fire spreads to every enemy pawn standing beside it, once.

cards.name: Thorn Barrier
cards.description: A hedge of thorns bursts up on an empty square: your opponent cannot enter the squares around it, save one gap left open as a bridge, for their next 3 turns, and any enemy piece already caught in that ring is snared and cannot move for its next 2 turns.

cards.name: Werewolf
cards.description: Curse one of your pawns with lycanthropy: every 5 of your turns it transforms into a knight, and 5 turns later back into a pawn, for the game. The first transformation holds until your opponent replies. If it promotes or is captured the curse lifts.

cards.name: Armored Breakthrough
cards.description: One of your bishops spearheads the drive: it sweeps along one diagonal, capturing every enemy piece on it, and stops where the drive ends. Friendly pieces and enemy kings block the drive, once.

cards.name: Bridgehead
cards.description: Place a new knight on an empty square in your half and a new pawn on an empty square on your fourth rank or lower, once.

cards.name: Combined Arms
cards.description: Armor learns from cavalry: for your next 3 turns, your rooks may also leap like knights.

cards.name: Counter Battery Fire
cards.description: Remove one enemy rook or bishop you name from the board, once.

cards.name: Double Trench
cards.description: Pick two files: your opponent cannot move onto either file for their next 2 turns, and any enemy piece standing on those files cannot capture in that time. Committing the trench spends the card even if it catches nothing.

cards.name: Forward Outpost
cards.description: Place a new rook on any empty square in your own half, once.

cards.name: Mercenary Queen
cards.description: Hire a sellsword who fights as a queen for 3 of your turns, then rides off with her pay.

cards.name: Pincer Movement
cards.description: Close both jaws at once: every enemy piece except a king caught directly between two of your pieces (left and right, above and below, or across a diagonal) is pinned and frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Praetorian Guard
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces: for your next 4 turns it cannot be captured and may also step one square in any direction like a king.

cards.name: Shieldbearers
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, while at least one of your pawns stands on a square beside your king, your king cannot be captured, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Absolute Aegis
cards.description: Every one of your pieces cannot be captured for 2 full turns, and this time that includes your king. But each protected piece loses its protection once it makes a capture.

cards.name: Aegis of the Ages
cards.description: Lift the ancient aegis and its ward falls over your whole host, your king included: nothing you own can be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns. Lifting it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Age of Heroes
cards.description: The old songs come true for three champions: choose one of your knights, one bishop, and one rook. Until each next moves it may also move like a queen, a single stroke apiece.

cards.name: Amazon
cards.description: Your queen is crowned an Amazon: she still moves like a queen and now banks a single knight leap, regaining one every four of your turns (never more than one banked), which she may spend to jump like a knight.

cards.name: Amazon Army
cards.description: For your next three turns your knights also move as bishops and your bishops also move as knights. Neither becomes a full amazon.

cards.name: Ban Hammer
cards.description: Moderator privileges activated: point at one enemy knight, bishop, or rook, and up to two enemy pieces of that type are permanently banned from the board.

cards.name: Ascension of the Small
cards.description: Choose one of your knights or bishops. After your opponent's next move, it ascends: it becomes a queen where it stands.

cards.name: Champion's Rest
cards.description: For the rest of the game, every rook or queen you capture suspends your nerf for your next 4 turns.

cards.name: Crown Commission
cards.description: You keep both cards of your next draft offer, at its usual tier.

cards.name: Debtor's Holiday
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 12 turns, and gain 2 draft rerolls.

cards.name: Drawbridge Crew
cards.description: Place three new pawns on empty squares on your second rank.

cards.name: Escape Artist
cards.description: For the rest of the game, whenever your king steps out of check, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Eye of Ages
cards.description: See both the cards and the tier of your opponent's next draft offer, gain 3 draft rerolls, and every enemy piece that no other enemy piece defends lights up until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Feast of Fools
cards.description: You keep both cards of your next draft offer, and gain 2 draft rerolls.

cards.name: The Grand Bargain
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 14 turns, and your next draft shows three cards, of which you keep one.

cards.name: Half-Moon Charter
cards.description: For the rest of the game, your nerf is suspended on every other one of your turns, starting with your next. The charter costs you your next two drafts, which are skipped.

cards.name: Harbor Queen
cards.description: For the rest of the game, your queen cannot be captured while she stands in your half of the board. Across the middle line she sails at her own risk.

cards.name: The Hundred Days
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 11 turns.

cards.name: Jubilee
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 8 turns, and your next draft offer rolls one tier higher.

cards.name: Keys to the City
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next 8 turns, used at the moment you choose. While suspended, your pieces ignore the boundaries your nerf would impose.

cards.name: Moonlit Reprieve
cards.description: For the rest of the game the moon keeps your schedule: your nerf is suspended for 2 of your turns, returns for 2, and so on.

cards.name: Palace Walls
cards.description: No enemy piece may move onto your second rank for your opponent's next 2 turns. Any enemy piece already standing there may still leave.

cards.name: Patron's Favor
cards.description: Your next draft offer is fated to deal tier 7 cards. The favor costs the draft after it, which is skipped.

cards.name: Promotion Charter
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, any pawn move of yours that reaches your opponent's second rank may promote to a queen on the spot, one rank early. The charter ends early the moment one such move captures.

cards.name: Salt in the Wound
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 12 turns. When it returns, take 20 seconds from your opponent's clock.

cards.name: Uphill Battle
cards.description: Beginning after your opponent's next move, while your opponent has more pieces than you (kings aside), your nerf stays suspended, with enough slack to carry you two turns past the deficit.

cards.name: Warden's Retirement
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 4 turns. For your opponent's next 4 turns, every capture you make suspends it for 2 more of your turns; this clause ends after two such captures.

cards.name: Brr Brr Patapim
cards.description: The cold finds whoever wanders alone: every enemy piece except the king with no friendly piece on any square beside it freezes solid for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Buff Siphon
cards.description: Steal two active buffs from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: Carnival of Masks
cards.description: Every one of your pieces except your king puts on another's mask: their types are shuffled among their squares at random. You keep exactly the same pieces, but nobody is where their powers say they are. Pawns never land on a first or last rank.

cards.name: Kingmaker's Pact
cards.description: Sign with the power behind every throne: for your opponent's next four turns, every one of your draft offers rolls one tier higher. In exchange you forfeit your draft rerolls now. The pact ends the moment your opponent spends a reroll.

cards.name: Restitution
cards.description: For every kind of piece where your opponent outnumbers you on the board, one of your captured pieces of that kind returns to the empty square nearest your home rank. The most valuable returning piece is rooted and cannot move on your next turn.

cards.name: Covenant of Return
cards.description: Swear the covenant and death loses its next three arguments: the next 3 of your pieces that are captured each return at once to the empty square nearest your home rank.

cards.name: Futures Market
cards.description: Take the whole of the next hand: your next draft deals its two cards at the usual tier and you keep both of them, with no draft skipped.

cards.name: High Stakes
cards.description: Sweep the table twice: you keep every card offered in each of your next 2 drafts instead of just one, and one of your drafts is skipped besides. In return you forfeit all of your rerolls, now and forever.

cards.name: Home Guard
cards.description: The threshold is warded for good: no enemy piece may ever move onto your first rank. Your back rank stays yours, and no enemy pawn can promote on it.

cards.name: Last Stand
cards.description: For the next 3 turns none of your pieces can be captured and your king cannot be taken, but the wall falls the instant one of your pieces makes a capture. Your next 3 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: Pretender to the Throne
cards.description: Crown a claimant waiting in the wings: a brand new queen joins your pocket, ready to be dropped onto an empty square on a later turn (that drop spends the turn). The court is not cheap - your next 2 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: The Homecoming
cards.description: Your best captured major and best captured minor return to the empty squares nearest your home rank. Your next 2 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: Vantage Point
cards.description: Dig in on the heights and they cannot dislodge you: any of your pieces (your king aside) standing on your opponent's back two ranks cannot be captured. Step back off the heights and it is fair game again.

cards.name: Cappuccino Assassino
cards.description: The espresso assassin strikes before the foam settles: the enemy piece nearest your king (never their king) is destroyed, and the two enemy pieces nearest the scene of the crime are stunned for their next turn.

cards.name: Celestial Ascension
cards.description: Your bishops ascend to a higher plane: for the game every one of them also moves in straight lines like a rook, wielding a queen's full reach.

cards.name: Chain Atomic
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, whenever a capture involves one of your pieces the capturing piece is destroyed, along with up to one enemy piece beside it, kings aside. No chains.

cards.name: Checkmate Denial
cards.description: Once, when your king would be captured, it survives and is moved to the nearest safe square in your own half. No timed immunity.

cards.name: Chisel Curse
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, turn the enemy piece you targeted into a walnut for 4 of their turns, and the enemy pieces then directly to its left and right into walnuts for 2 of their turns each. Kings are never affected.

cards.name: Cockatrice Gaze
cards.description: Every enemy knight and bishop in your half turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns. Minors still in their own half only catch the reflection and are frozen for 1 turn. The first piece the gaze lands on petrifies only after their next move, and escapes if moved.

cards.name: Contagion
cards.description: The strain lies dormant until after your opponent's next move. Once it wakes, whenever one of their pieces is newly frozen, one adjacent enemy piece, never a king, catches it and is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Court in Exile
cards.description: On your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only their king, and their queen is the last to return from exile: she cannot move for 2 further turns after the court comes back.

cards.name: Chat Picks: Creator vs Chat
cards.description: Chat rolls two of its four penalties and pins one on you at random for your next 10 turns. In exchange, you take both cards in your next draft.

cards.name: Cramling Family Night
cards.description: Choose one enemy piece. For 4 turns nobody may capture it, each player sees the cards in the other's next draft, and the biggest piece each side is attacking wears a name tag.

cards.name: Deep Freeze
cards.description: A cold snap rolls over their homeland: every enemy piece except the king still in its own half is frozen for 2 of their turns. Pieces that already crossed the border escape it.

cards.name: Divine Legion
cards.description: Add a queen to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

cards.name: Draft Tyranny
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, both cards in your next draft are set to tier 7, once.

cards.name: Dragon's Breath
cards.description: One rook captures every enemy piece in a straight line in a single move, once. Loosing the breath spends the card even if the line is empty and nothing burns.

cards.name: Dragonslayer
cards.description: The old blade remembers its work: name one enemy rook or queen and it is slain where it stands. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Fingertip Maltese
cards.description: Elite fingertip hold on one enemy piece: it freezes for their next 3 turns and the empty squares around it are sealed, so no fresh piece can move in to rescue it, though pieces already beside it may leave normally.

cards.name: Royal Road
cards.description: Your king steps to any empty square on your back rank.

cards.name: King's Moat
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns none of their pieces may move onto a square next to your king.

cards.name: Sunforge
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns on your 5th rank or beyond. It becomes a knight where it stands.

cards.name: Frozen Solid
cards.description: Freeze one enemy piece and one enemy piece next to it for 3 of their turns each. Kings cannot be chosen. The piece you target freezes only after your opponent's next move, and escapes if they move it away.

cards.name: Full Pardon
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 12 turns and store one bonus move: after your opponent's next move you take an extra move on your following turn.

cards.name: Genesis
cards.description: Reset the entire board to the opening position, once. Every lingering effect is washed away.

cards.name: Glacial Tomb
cards.description: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for 1 of their turns. As the ice lifts, only their queen and rooks stay behind as walnuts for 1 more turn, able to shuffle only one square at a time.

cards.name: Break the Bank
cards.description: Three laser grids, 60% each to slip through. Three clean: your best captured piece returns AND a random tier 6 card joins your hand. Two: the tier 6 card. One: a pawn, and a random piece of yours is jailed 2 turns. Zero: two pieces jailed 2 turns.

cards.name: Devil's Deck
cards.description: Six cards fanned face up, three drawn at random, all three resolve. The blessings: summon a knight, stun three enemy pieces, revive a captured minor, shield your army for a turn. The two curses: lose a random pawn, or freeze one of your minors for 2 turns.

cards.name: God Knight
cards.description: One knight becomes an amazon (queen plus knight), for the game.

cards.name: Golden Touch
cards.description: The next two enemy pieces you capture (other than kings) are reforged as your own and added to your army on empty squares in your half. The price of greed: each reforging turns one of your pawns to gold, and it is lost.

cards.name: Grand Malediction
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn.

cards.name: Grand Nullify
cards.description: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs. Locked-in upgrades resist. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Grand Resurrection
cards.description: Revive your queen to your half.

cards.name: Great Divide
cards.description: One full rank you pick becomes impassable to enemies for your opponent's next 2 turns. Pieces already standing on that rank may still leave it.

cards.name: Hex of Stone
cards.description: Every one of your opponent's knights and bishops turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, though the first affected piece may make one move first. For those same 4 turns their rooks and queen may slide no more than two squares.

cards.name: Crown of Thorns
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns, any enemy piece whose move leaves your king in check is seized by the thorns and frozen for 2 of their turns where it stands. The check still counts; the attacker is simply rooted.

cards.name: The Hollow Crown
cards.description: For the rest of the game, whenever your opponent's king moves, castling included, the court mourns: on their following turn they may move only pawns or the king.

cards.name: Tide of Ash
cards.description: Their 1st rank is buried at once, and the tide swallows one more home rank on each of their next 3 turns, up to their 4th. No enemy piece may move ONTO buried ground, but a piece already standing in it may leave normally. It blows away after their 6th turn.

cards.name: Doomed Vow
cards.description: Condemn one enemy piece: in 4 of their turns it is dragged off the board, unless their own king comes to stand on a square next to it first, which breaks the vow at once. Kings themselves cannot be condemned.

cards.name: The Long Eclipse
cards.description: It holds off until after their next move. Then for their next 3 turns nothing seems wrong, and for the 3 turns after that their bishops and queen are blind and cannot move at all. Knights, rooks, pawns and king see fine throughout.

cards.name: The Enemy Within
cards.description: Whisper treason to one enemy rook or queen. It holds off until after their next move, then over the next 8 of their turns the third time they move that piece it defects: it serves you for your next 4 turns, then returns. Kings never turn.

cards.name: Feeding Frenzy
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns their bishops, rooks and queen have their reach capped, and the cap tightens for every other curse already afflicting them: each frozen or petrified piece, sealed square, or royal edict.

cards.name: Pyrrhic Toll
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns, each time any of their pieces captures, the army mourns and one of their other pieces is frozen for 1 of their turns. Kings never mourn.

cards.name: Broken Supply
cards.description: Their supply wagon is looted: your opponent's next drafted card arrives nullified. They still pick; the card does nothing.

cards.name: Clipped Diagonals
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their bishops and queen may slide at most 2 squares along diagonals. Straight queen moves are untouched. The first piece the clip would rein in may slide freely once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Command Paralysis
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns they may only move pieces standing in your half of the board. The first piece the silence would stop may move once regardless, then it binds fully. If they have none in your half, they move freely that turn.

cards.name: Crossbow Curfew
cards.description: Ranged warfare is outlawed: after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns they may only capture from 1 square away. Long range kills are forbidden.

cards.name: Crown Malaise
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their queen is bedridden every other turn (the 1st and 3rd) and cannot move on those turns.

cards.name: Eclipse
cards.description: The sun goes out over their camp: their pawns cannot advance for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Field of Spears
cards.description: Your pawns raise a hedge of spears: for your opponent's next 3 turns, their pieces may not stop on any square one of your pawns attacks. A piece already standing on such a square may leave it freely. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Flooded Flanks
cards.description: Both edge files (a and h) flood: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on them for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Glass Floor
cards.description: Every dark square becomes thin glass: for your opponent's next 2 turns their pieces may not stop on dark squares. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Gorgon Field
cards.description: A gorgon's gaze sweeps the middle of the board: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that ends a move on the central 4x4 (c3 to f6) becomes a walnut for 1 of their turns. Kings resist the gaze.

cards.name: Grim Procession
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, no piece of theirs may end a move farther from their own king than it started. The army huddles toward the crown. Their king walks free.

cards.name: Muster of Silence
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any piece of theirs that is defended by another of their pieces may not move. Only the unguarded stragglers may act. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Royal Quarantine
cards.description: Their king is declared contagious: for your opponent's next 4 turns, none of their pieces may end a move adjacent to their own king. The king itself moves freely. The first piece the quarantine would turn away may make one such move, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Scorched Diagonal
cards.description: The great a1 to h8 diagonal burns: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on its 8 squares for their next 3 turns, save one bridge square left cool. Since the defender cannot pick here, the bridge is the diagonal square nearest their king.

cards.name: Stone Orchard
cards.description: All of your opponent's knights and bishops turn to walnuts for 1 of their turns: heavy nuts that can only shuffle one square. One resists: the affected piece nearest the a1 corner keeps its footing.

cards.name: The Long Night
cards.description: Darkness swallows their camp: for your opponent's next 2 turns, every piece they own may move at most 1 square. Pieces already standing in their own half may leave normally, and king captures are always allowed.

cards.name: Treacle Tide
cards.description: Treacle seeps in slowly: your opponent's next move passes freely, then for their following 4 turns, any piece of theirs standing in their own half may move at most 1 square. Their king is exempt, and pieces already in your half are free.

cards.name: Veil of Moths
cards.description: A living veil settles over your half of the board: for your opponent's next 3 turns, they cannot capture anything standing in your half.

cards.name: Watchman's Whistle
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns, any piece of theirs that gives check to your king is arrested on the spot and frozen for 2 of their turns. Kings are never arrested.

cards.name: Wheel of Ice
cards.description: A ribbon of ice sweeps one file per turn, starting at the a-file: for your opponent's next 4 turns, their pieces on the current icy file cannot move. Their king is exempt. The first piece the ice would pin may move once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: I Love Cami
cards.description: Place Cami on an empty square in your half: a queen who also leaps like a knight. Devotion: allies standing beside her cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns. If she is ever taken, her captor is frozen for 2 turns.

cards.name: I Love My Sister
cards.description: Bring your strongest fallen piece home to an empty square in your half. She arrives shielded, uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns, but the shield ends once she has made two captures.

cards.name: Joseph Leung
cards.description: Sign the board. Bind one of your pieces: for the game it moves as a knight and queen at once, and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Judgment Day
cards.description: A pillar of holy light smites one enemy knight, bishop, rook, or queen you name, then petrifies the two enemy pieces nearest the impact into stone for the rest of the game. Kings are never petrified.

cards.name: King's Legion
cards.description: Add a rook and a knight to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Leaden Limbs
cards.description: Your opponent may move each piece at most one square in any direction for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Magnetism
cards.description: Your knights are magnetized: after each knight move, the nearest enemy piece (never a king) is dragged up to two squares toward that knight, as long as the squares between them are empty.

cards.name: Mass Freeze
cards.description: After your opponent replies, freeze every enemy piece except the king for 1 full turn.

cards.name: Meteor
cards.description: Pick an impact square, then a rank or a file through it, not both. Remove up to three enemy pieces on that line, kings aside, nearest the impact square.

cards.name: Molten Heart
cards.description: Their blades run molten: for your opponent's next 2 captures, the capturing piece is destroyed along with its victim. Their single most valuable piece is exempt and captures freely, and kings burn nothing and are never destroyed.

cards.name: Nerf Reversal
cards.description: Turn your nerf against itself: suspend it for your next 10 turns, and your pieces in your own half cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Noble Rout
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, the nobles break and run: for their following 3 turns their knights, bishops, rooks and queen cannot move toward your side of the board. Only their pawns and king may still advance.

cards.name: All the King's Men
cards.description: Up to four of your captured pieces return at once, strongest first, on random empty squares in your half.

cards.name: The Big Nap
cards.description: Night falls: every knight, bishop, rook and queen on the board (both sides) sleeps and cannot move for 1 turn of its owner. Kings and pawns keep watch.

cards.name: Coup d'Etat
cards.description: The queen takes the throne: she cannot be captured for your opponent's next 6 turns, and for 6 of your turns your king moves like a queen.

cards.name: Great Migration
cards.description: As your move, every one of your pawns with an empty square ahead advances one square. Blocked pawns hold their ground.

cards.name: Living Board
cards.description: Two 2x2 areas (neither containing a king, away from the back ranks) trade their entire contents, square for square. Then one of your pieces that moved may take a free king-step to an empty adjacent square, without capturing.

cards.name: Patient Grift
cards.description: Fold twice to win the pot: your next 2 drafts are skipped, and the draft after them is dealt from tier 8.

cards.name: Puppet Coronation
cards.description: Choose the enemy queen and an empty square she could legally reach. After your opponent's next move, the strings pull and she is marched there, if she still stands where you chose and the square is still empty. No captures.

cards.name: Symphony of the Legion
cards.description: Three movements, each a free action, at most one per your turn, in order: first every pawn you own advances a square; second each of your knights and bishops drifts one random empty step; third your rooks and queen may pass through friendly pieces this turn.

cards.name: Phoenix Line
cards.description: Revive all your captured pawns to your 2nd rank, once.

cards.name: Purge Line
cards.description: Remove every enemy piece below queen rank on one rank you pick.

cards.name: Queen Storm
cards.description: Promote up to two of your pawns on your 4th rank or beyond: the first becomes a queen, the second a rook. No two promotions are alike, so there is no mass of queens.

cards.name: Queen's Rampage
cards.description: In one move, your queen sweeps along one straight line you choose and removes every enemy piece on it; a friendly piece or an enemy king ends the line, once.

cards.name: Resurrect Queen
cards.description: Bring your captured queen back to any empty square on the board, and she cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Roost of Rocs
cards.description: Three titanic rocs descend and perch along the board's edge: place three knights on empty squares of the outer rim, then skip your next draft.

cards.name: Roulette
cards.description: Spin the wheel three times: three random enemy pieces other than the king are removed from the board.

cards.name: Ruin
cards.description: Clear all enemy pawns, and destroy one enemy minor piece (or a rook if they have no minor).

cards.name: Sabbatical
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next 10 turns, used at the moment you choose, but your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Soul Harvest
cards.description: Your queen sweeps one diagonal, reaping every enemy piece she passes and landing on an empty square beyond them, never on a capture; for each piece reaped, a friendly pawn rises on an empty square in your half, plus one bonus pawn, once.

cards.name: Sovereign Draft
cards.description: Take both cards in your next draft, that draft rolls one tier higher, and you see the tier of your opponent's next offer.

cards.name: Stone Prelates
cards.description: The pews claim whoever lingers: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any of their bishops standing in their own half may only shuffle one square at a time. Bishops that cross into your half move freely.

cards.name: Summon Dragon
cards.description: Choose an empty square in your half now, and after your opponent's next move a new queen lands there, so she cannot capture until they reply. Whenever she captures she breathes fire: every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around her kill dies too.

cards.name: Termites
cards.description: Termites gnaw at your opponent's towers: every 2 of their turns, their rooks lose one more square of reach. The decay stops at a reach of 1, so a rook can always shuffle a single square.

cards.name: Threads of Fate
cards.description: The loom repays every cut thread: for your opponent's next 3 captures, you weave an extra move into your reply.

cards.name: Throne and Silence
cards.description: For your opponent's next turn they may move only their king or their single most valuable piece, and their next draft is skipped entirely.

cards.name: Total Atomic
cards.description: Your next three captures each detonate one square in every direction, destroying up to two adjacent enemy pieces. Shielded pieces resist, and the blast never chains.

cards.name: Total Warp
cards.description: Teleport your whole army except the king anywhere you like, once. Pawns stay off the first and last ranks.

cards.name: Total Whiteout
cards.description: A blizzard buries every sightline: for their next 3 turns, your opponent's pieces can only capture at arm's length, exactly one square away.

cards.name: Triple Amazon
cards.description: Up to three of your knights move as amazons for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Twin Queens
cards.description: Promote two pawns to queens instantly if both are on your 5th rank or beyond. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Unshackled Wrath
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 14 turns, then it returns at full strength. Your opponent skips their next turn.

cards.name: Grand Dominion
cards.description: Take control of one enemy rook or queen: it becomes yours, once.

cards.name: Greed
cards.description: Your next draft offer, you take both cards instead of choosing one.

cards.name: Genie Wish
cards.description: You wished for a queen and the genie obliges, with a flourish of fine print: a new queen appears in your pocket, and a knight appears in your OPPONENT'S. Both drop onto empty squares on later turns, and the fine print costs you your next draft.

cards.name: Sticky Floor
cards.description: The whole floor is flypaper: every one of your opponent's pieces may move at most one square for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Whiteout
cards.description: A blizzard freezes every enemy piece except the king and pawns for their next turn. The pawns can still trudge.

cards.name: The Wild Hunt
cards.description: The horns of the twilight court sound: pick any square, and the Hunt rides both diagonals through it, carrying off every enemy piece on them. Kings are never taken.

cards.name: Withered Hands
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, they cannot capture with any piece for their following 3 turns.

cards.name: Dug-In Defense
cards.description: Dig four foxholes: choose up to four of your pieces; they cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Iron Bulwark
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces, your king aside: while it stands in your half it cannot be captured, and enemy pieces standing next to it cannot capture at all.

cards.name: Abdication Edict
cards.description: For your opponent's next turn they may move only their king. For the two turns after that, they may also move their single most valuable non-king piece, chosen fresh each turn; every other piece stays stuck fast.

cards.name: Absolute Nullify
cards.description: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs and block their next draft, but they gain a reroll in return. Locked-in upgrades resist.

cards.name: Absolute Zero
cards.description: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king and pawns for 2 of their turns. The cold outlives the ice: for their next 2 turns after the thaw, each of those pieces can only step a single square. Kings and pawns move freely throughout.

cards.name: Annihilation
cards.description: Remove any two enemy pieces below the queen from the board.

cards.name: Atomic Captures
cards.description: Whenever one of your pieces captures, every enemy piece on the 8 squares around the captured square is also removed, except kings and pawns. Lasts the whole game.

cards.name: Berserker
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, all your pieces except your king also move like a queen. For the 2 turns after that, all your pieces can move only one square.

cards.name: Blighted Furrows
cards.description: Every enemy pawn standing in your half rots away and is removed, and their remaining pawns cannot advance for their next 4 turns, though the first pawn to try may make one advance before the lock takes hold.

cards.name: Age of Peace
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, each of your pieces cannot be captured and your king cannot be taken. A protected piece loses its protection once it makes a capture.

cards.name: Council of Peace
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 8 turns; for your opponent's next 2 turns each of your pieces cannot be captured and your king cannot be taken. A protected piece loses its protection once it makes a capture.

cards.name: Crown Jubilee
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 15 turns, and your next draft shows three cards, of which you keep one.

cards.name: Deck of Kings
cards.description: Your next draft offer rolls one tier higher.

cards.name: Flag on Their Wall
cards.description: While any piece of yours stands on your opponent's back rank, your nerf is suspended.

cards.name: Founding of the City
cards.description: Place a new knight on an empty square on your home rank.

cards.name: The Great Armistice
cards.description: Both players' nerfs are suspended for their next 10 turns, and neither side's pieces can be captured on the opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Hall of Doors
cards.description: For your next 5 turns, your king may step through any door: he may move to any empty square in your half of the board. Once, one other piece of yours (your king excepted) may also step to any empty square in your half.

cards.name: Haven Law
cards.description: Beginning after your opponent's next move, nothing of yours standing in your own half of the board can be captured for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Hundred-Year Lease
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, the lease begins: your nerf is suspended for the 30 turns that follow.

cards.name: Liberator's March
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 18 turns. Each capture you make while it is suspended gains you 1 draft reroll, up to 3.

cards.name: The Long Winter
cards.description: Every enemy piece (their king excepted) is frozen for your opponent's next 2 turns, and your king cannot be captured on their next turn, unless your king makes a capture, which ends that safety.

cards.name: Masked Ball
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 6 turns, and your knights and bishops cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: The Meek Inherit
cards.description: Beginning after your opponent's next move, your nerf is suspended while your opponent has at least as many pieces as you (kings aside). Pull ahead in material, and it wakes.

cards.name: Menagerie Gates
cards.description: The gates open: a knight, a bishop and a pawn all join your pocket, ready to be dropped onto empty squares on later turns (each drop spends that turn).

cards.name: Midas Charter
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every one of your drafts rolls one tier higher; it ends early if your opponent spends a draft reroll. The gold rush costs your next 2 drafts, which are skipped.

cards.name: Pact of the Dawn
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 12 turns, and every one of your captured pawns returns at once to squares nearest your home rank. The most advanced returning pawn cannot move until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Queen's Aegis
cards.description: While your queen stands on the board, your nerf is suspended. Lose her, and it returns.

cards.name: Return of the Queen
cards.description: Your captured queen returns to an empty square on your home rank. She cannot capture until your opponent has replied.

cards.name: Royal Privilege
cards.description: For the rest of the game, every time you move your queen, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns. Your next 2 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: The Royal We
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 7 turns, and your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Siege Mentality
cards.description: For the rest of the game, whenever your opponent puts your king in check, your nerf is suspended for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: Tide of Pawns
cards.description: For the rest of the game, each of your pawns may once advance two squares in one move from wherever it stands (both squares ahead must be empty, and it may not land on your seventh or eighth rank). The charge is spent per pawn and never refreshes.

cards.name: The Unequal Treaty
cards.description: Your nerf is suspended for your next 10 turns; your opponent's is suspended for their next 3. Diplomacy, as practiced.

cards.name: Written in Stone
cards.description: After your next 10 turns, the inscription takes effect: your nerf is suspended for the 20 turns that follow.

cards.name: Year of Jubilee
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 25 turns. When it returns, gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Bombardiro Crocodilo
cards.description: Paint a square, then the payload drops after your opponent's next move: up to four enemy pieces except kings in the 5 by 5 area centred on it are destroyed, the four nearest the centre first. Anything that flees the area before it lands is spared.

cards.name: Boneca Ambalabu
cards.description: The tire-frog drags your opponent down: for their next 4 turns none of their pieces may move more than 1 square in a single move.

cards.name: Buff Plunder
cards.description: Steal two active buffs from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: The Great Return
cards.description: Every captured piece of BOTH sides still owed to the board returns at once, each placed on the empty square nearest its own home rank. Your most valuable returning piece arrives rooted and cannot move on your next turn.

cards.name: The Long Truce
cards.description: Heralds cross the field and every blade is lowered: for 2 full turns, no piece on EITHER side can be captured, kings included. While the truce holds you breathe freely: your own nerf is suspended for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: Shadow Reserve
cards.description: A knight, a bishop and a rook join your pocket to drop onto empty squares on later turns. Your next 2 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: Drive Them Out
cards.description: Clear the homeland and let the invaders regret the crossing: every enemy piece standing in your half of the board is removed, and every one of your own pieces standing in your opponent's half is removed with them. Both kings are spared.

cards.name: The Reckoning
cards.description: Call in every debt the minor pieces owe: every knight and every bishop on the board, yours and your opponent's alike, is removed at once. Kings, queens, rooks and pawns are untouched.

cards.name: Cataclysmic Meteor
cards.description: Pick a 3x3 area. Remove up to three enemy pieces in it, kings aside. If more than three are present the least valuable are destroyed, so the defender keeps their strongest.

cards.name: Celestial Alignment
cards.description: The stars chart the light squares and hold everything found there: every enemy piece except the king standing on a light square is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Danya's Speedrun
cards.description: For your opponent's next 6 turns they may only play a capture, a check, or a pawn move. Each held turn pays you more time: 2 seconds, then 3, then 4, and so on.

cards.name: Divine Fortress
cards.description: Every piece on your half of the board, your king aside, is uncapturable for 3 turns, but while the fortress stands those pieces cannot give check.

cards.name: Divine Right
cards.description: For your next 5 turns your king may move and capture as a queen, and it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Draft Supremacy
cards.description: Take both cards in each of your next two drafts while your opponent's next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Endless Night
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn. On the turn they return, up to four non-king enemy pieces you choose are frozen for that one turn.

cards.name: Eternal Reign
cards.description: Your king gains permanent queen movement and cannot be captured for 3 turns.

cards.name: Extinction
cards.description: Remove every enemy minor and pawn from the board except one: the defender's strongest such piece is spared.

cards.name: Worldheart
cards.description: Take two extra moves right now. Your army cannot be captured until your next turn begins.

cards.name: Eclipse Crown
cards.description: Your opponent's next turn is skipped, and none of your pieces can be captured until your following turn begins.

cards.name: Winter Court
cards.description: Every enemy piece other than the king standing in your half of the board is frozen for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: The Last Bet
cards.description: Push your queen across the felt. 70%: she returns empowered, adding knight leaps to her slides for 6 of your turns, though those leaps cannot capture. 30%: the back room keeps her for 2 of your turns, then returns her to her square or the nearest empty one.

cards.name: Godslayer Knight
cards.description: One knight moves as an amazon, is uncapturable, and explodes on capture, for 3 turns. While shielded it cannot give check.

cards.name: Grand Reset
cards.description: Add replacements to your pocket until your army would be back to full starting strength, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns. You skip your next draft in exchange.

cards.name: Heaven's Wrath
cards.description: The sky splits and three bolts of wrath descend: smite three enemy knights, bishops, rooks, or queens you name from the board. Calling the storm consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Death Knell
cards.description: Toll the knell over one enemy piece: in 3 of their turns it crumbles to dust and is removed. The bell accepts one bribe: if the doomed piece captures anything before the last toll, the curse breaks and it lives. Kings cannot be tolled.

cards.name: Blood Tithe
cards.description: It holds off until after their next move, then for their next 6 turns: whenever they capture anything larger than a pawn, one of their own pawns is claimed as tribute and removed from the board. Once they have no pawns left, the tithe goes unpaid.

cards.name: Martyr's Crown
cards.description: A patient briar guards your king for your opponent's next 6 turns. The first check passes; on the second, every enemy piece standing next to your king is frozen for 2 of their turns and the count resets. Their two best pieces there are spared.

cards.name: Blood Price
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, killing has a price: their first capture in that window costs them their following turn, skipped outright; their second capture instead freezes the capturing piece for 2 of their turns. Kings never freeze.

cards.name: Debt of Crowns
cards.description: The crown's debts are called in: your opponent's next draft is skipped outright, and in the draft after it one card arrives nullified. Since only the card they pick is nullified, the rest of that offer is protected by their own choice.

cards.name: Doomsday Clock
cards.description: A great clock ticks in full view: after 3 of your opponent's turns, every piece of theirs then standing in your half becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns. If none are there, their most advanced piece is frozen for 1 turn instead.

cards.name: Echo Chamber
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, they may not move a piece of the same type as the piece you moved on your previous turn. Their king is always allowed.

cards.name: Eternal Toll
cards.description: The border's toll comes late but without mercy: your opponent's next move crosses free, then for their following 6 turns, any piece of theirs that crosses the midline into your half is frozen for 1 of their turns on arrival. Kings cross free.

cards.name: Glass Prison
cards.description: Seal one enemy rook or queen you target inside a glass bubble: it is frozen for 3 of their turns, in full view and utterly stuck.

cards.name: The Great Glacier
cards.description: A glacier grinds across their army: every enemy piece except pawns and the king is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: The Great Waltz
cards.description: The board itself calls the dance: your opponent's next move passes freely, then for their following 3 turns they may only move pieces standing on the color the waltz names, dark squares first, then light, then dark. Their king may always dance.

cards.name: The Last Toll
cards.description: The great bell rings twice: your opponent skips their next turn, and on the turn after that they may only move a pawn or their king. When the bell falls silent, they bank one draft reroll for the turn after it ends.

cards.name: Maze of Thorns
cards.description: Thorn hedges spring up across every lane: for your opponent's next 4 turns, no piece of theirs may move more than 1 square, except knights, who leap the hedges. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Puppet Court
cards.description: Every officer's strings are cut: for your opponent's next 3 turns they may move only pawns and their king. The first officer the strings would bind may make one move, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Royal Lockdown
cards.description: Their realm grinds to a halt: your opponent skips their next turn, and on their first turn after that they may move only a pawn, a knight, or their king.

cards.name: Sated Blades
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, each of their pieces may kill only once: a piece that captures in that window cannot capture again until the curse lifts.

cards.name: Shattered Council
cards.description: Their war council collapses: their queen and both rooks are frozen for 1 of their turns, and their next drafted card arrives nullified. In recompense for the ruined council, their next offer deals three cards to choose from instead of two.

cards.name: Tempest
cards.description: 6 random empty squares become wreckage your opponent cannot stop on for their next 3 turns, save one bridge, the wreckage nearest their king. 2 of their pieces, chosen at random, are also stunned for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: The Long Siege
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their pawns cannot advance; diagonal captures remain legal, and their most advanced pawn may still advance each turn.

cards.name: Tithe of Silence
cards.description: Your opponent's next move passes freely. Then, for their following 6 turns, shouting at a king is taxed: each of their first 2 checks against your king costs them their following turn, skipped outright.

cards.name: The Tolling Thirds
cards.description: A funeral bell counts your opponent's turns: on their 3rd and 6th turns from now, a piece of theirs is frozen for 1 of their turns. Their single most valuable piece is immune, never the king, so the bell takes their next most valuable instead.

cards.name: The Winter That Stays
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns, any piece of theirs that travels more than 2 squares in one move arrives frostbitten and is frozen for 1 of their turns. The first such piece shakes off the frost; every long traveler after it freezes. Kings endure the cold.

cards.name: I Love My GF
cards.description: Your pieces standing in your own half cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn, and you take one bonus move right now. Your king shares the shield only if it is currently in check.

cards.name: I Hate My Ex
cards.description: Bring the whole thing down. Every piece on the board is destroyed instantly, yours and theirs alike. Only the two kings are left standing in the wreckage.

cards.name: Immortal King
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 8 turns, but this protection ends the instant your king captures a piece. You can still lose by running out of moves.

cards.name: Lost Fortnight
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn, and 20 seconds are struck off their clock.

cards.name: Mass Mind Control
cards.description: Mark two enemy pieces of any type below queen. After your opponent's next move, any of them still in place defect to your side for the game.

cards.name: Basilisk's Stare
